items.title: 〈熱門股〉技嘉Q2大賺66億元寫新猷 股價周漲15%外資力挺連10買
items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Gigabyte Posts Q2 Profit of NT$6.6 Billion, Sets New Record; Stock Up 15% This Week, Foreign Investors Backed with Ten Consecutive Buys
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)受惠AI伺服器出貨強勁，第二季與上半年獲利雙雙改寫歷史新高，本周買盤持續湧入，4日股價最高攻上402元，終場上漲4元，收在397.5元，本周股價累計強漲15.55%，周成交量59587張，其中外資已連十買，買超3.6萬張。
面對AI算力需求持續升溫，技嘉管理層表示下半年訂單能見度大幅提高，隨著客戶基礎設施建置與關鍵零組件供應改善，整體營收與營運成長力道將更勝上半年，因此將今年全年資本支出由原先的23億至25億元，進一步上修至28億至30億元，全力擴增伺服器廠房產能及機器設備。
在產業趨勢與新平台布局上，法人指出第二季雖為板卡傳統淡季且記憶體價格走揚，但技嘉在GB300伺服器機櫃放量下呈現淡季不淡，伺服器占整體營收比重持續攀升，加上輝達即將推出RTX SPARK超級電腦平台，技嘉預計明年首季推出相關新機種搶市，可望為下一波換機潮注入全新營運動能。
paras_en: Gigabyte (2376‑TW), a PC brand, benefited from strong AI server shipments, achieving record‑high profits for both Q2 and the first half of the year. Buying pressure kept flowing this week; on the 4th the stock peaked at NT$402, closed up NT$4 at NT$397.5, and rose a cumulative 15.55% for the week on a volume of 59,587 lots, with foreign investors buying for ten consecutive sessions and netting a purchase of 36,000 lots.

Facing sustained warming of AI compute demand, Gigabyte’s management said order visibility for the second half of the year has improved dramatically. With customers expanding infrastructure and key component supply easing, overall revenue and operating growth are expected to outpace the first half. Consequently, the company raised its full‑year capital expenditure target from the original NT$23‑25 billion to NT$28‑30 billion to fully expand server plant capacity and equipment.

Regarding industry trends and new platform positioning, analysts noted that although Q2 is traditionally a slow season for expansion cards and memory prices are rising, Gigabyte’s GB300 server chassis saw strong volume, keeping the season lively. The share of server revenue in total sales continues to climb, and with Nvidia set to launch the RTX SPARK supercomputer platform, Gigabyte plans to roll out related new models in Q1 next year, which could inject fresh operating momentum into the next wave of hardware upgrades.

items.title: OpenAI財務長：企業營收已超越消費者業務
items.title_en: OpenAI CFO: Enterprise Revenue Exceeds Consumer Business
paras: 《CNBC》報導，在OpenAI高層經歷動盪的一周後，財務長Sarah Friar周五(14日)與投資人舉行會議，強調公司企業業務的成長。她表示，目前企業業務的營收已超越以ChatGPT為主的消費者業務。
一名出席會議的知情人士透露，Friar在會中表示，「我們今年初的比例是60比40，但企業業務成長速度遠超預期，如今兩者的比例已經交叉。目前我們大部分的營收都來自企業業務。」
這代表OpenAI的企業業務成長已超越先前預期。Friar今年稍早接受CNBC採訪時曾表示，公司原本預期這兩項業務將在2026年底達到相當規模。OpenAI目前的年化營收規模已達400億美元。
根據CNBC看到的簡報資料，OpenAI的年化營收7月較前一個月增加20%，企業客戶營收成長速度更快，增加32%。
知情人士表示，周五的投資人會議在本周高層離職事件發生前就已安排，參與者為OpenAI現有股東。會議舉行前一天，營收長Denise Dresser宣布離職，上任僅8個月。Dresser曾在Salesforce(CRM-US)任職超過10年，最近則擔任Slack執行長。她在LinkedIn發文表示，將離開公司尋求其他發展機會。
兩天前，OpenAI資深高層Brad Lightcap也宣布結束自己在這家ChatGPT開發商長達8年的任期。
OpenAI總裁兼共同創辦人Greg Brockman也參加了周五的會議。知情人士表示，Brockman感謝Dresser對公司的貢獻，以及她為企業業務奠定的基礎，並對接替她的Dali Rajic表示期待。Rajic此前擔任網路安全公司Wiz的營運長，Wiz目前已由Google(GOOGL-US)收購。
知情人士透露，Rajic是透過Thrive創辦人Josh Kushner的介紹加入OpenAI。
與會高層也被問及中國開源模型崛起所帶來的競爭。知情人士表示，Brockman淡化了這項競爭威脅，並指出市場對「開源模型比較便宜」存在誤解。
高層也被問到公司何時可能進行首次公開募股(IPO)。但由於OpenAI已向美國證券管理委員會(SEC)提交機密文件，管理層無法對此談論。
Friar在會中強調營收成長，並表示公司正在因應客戶使用方式的改變。所謂的「狂燒Token」(tokenmaxxing)時代已經過去，也就是企業不再允許員工在沒有展現足夠產出的情況下，無限制累積龐大的AI支出。
知情人士引述Friar的說法指出，「企業客戶已經從狂燒Token轉向關注每單位智慧的成本。」她並強調，OpenAI最新模型在代理型程式設計任務上的效率提高54%，同時公司近期也下調了旗下模型系列的價格。
Friar也表示，OpenAI在廣告業務方面「取得重大進展」。該名知情人士指出，OpenAI廣告業務的年化營收規模已接近10億美元。OpenAI今年2月開始在ChatGPT測試廣告。
paras_en: CNBC reported that OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar held a meeting with investors on Friday (14th) after a week of turmoil among the company's top executives, emphasizing the growth of the company's enterprise business. She stated that the current revenue of the enterprise business has surpassed that of the consumer business led by ChatGPT.

A source who attended the meeting revealed that Friar stated in the meeting, "We were at 60-40 at the beginning of this year, but the growth rate of the enterprise business far exceeded our expectations, and now the two have crossed over. Most of our revenue now comes from the enterprise business."

This represents that OpenAI's enterprise business has grown beyond previous expectations. Friar had previously stated in an interview with CNBC that the company expected the two businesses to reach a similar scale by the end of 2026. OpenAI's annual revenue has now reached $40 billion.

According to the presentation materials seen by CNBC, OpenAI's annual revenue increased by 20% in July compared to the previous month, with enterprise customer revenue growth even faster, increasing by 32%.

The source stated that the investor meeting on Friday had been scheduled before the high-level departure event this week, and the participants were existing shareholders of OpenAI. The day before the meeting, revenue chief Denise Dresser announced her resignation, having been in office for only 8 months. Dresser had worked at Salesforce (CRM-US) for over 10 years and had recently served as the CEO of Slack. She stated on LinkedIn that she would be leaving the company to seek new development opportunities.
Two days ago, OpenAI's senior executive Brad Lightcap also announced the end of his 8-year tenure at the company, which developed ChatGPT.

OpenAI CEO and co-founder Greg Brockman also attended the meeting on Friday. The source stated that Brockman thanked Dresser for her contributions to the company and the foundation she laid for the enterprise business, and expressed his expectations for her replacement, Dali Rajic. Rajic had previously served as the operating chief of network security company Wiz, which was acquired by Google (GOOGL-US).
The source revealed that Rajic was introduced to OpenAI through Thrive founder Josh Kushner.

The attending executives were also asked about the competition brought by the rise of open-source models in China. The source stated that Brockman downplayed the threat of this competition and pointed out that the market had a misconception about the cost-effectiveness of open-source models.

The executives were also asked when the company might conduct its initial public offering (IPO). However, since OpenAI had submitted confidential documents to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the management team was unable to discuss this.

Friar emphasized revenue growth in the meeting and stated that the company is responding to changes in customer usage patterns. The "tokenmaxxing" era is over, meaning that companies no longer allow employees to accumulate large AI expenses without demonstrating sufficient output.

The source quoted Friar as saying, "Enterprise customers have moved from tokenmaxxing to focusing on the cost of each unit of intelligence." She emphasized that OpenAI's latest model has improved efficiency by 54% in proxy programming tasks, and the company has recently reduced the prices of its model series.

Friar also stated that OpenAI has made "significant progress" in its advertising business. The source stated that OpenAI's annual revenue from advertising has reached nearly $1 billion. OpenAI began testing advertising on ChatGPT in February this year.

items.title: 五大發卡行7月刷卡量3332億元季節性回落 中信銀重返雙冠王
items.title_en: Five Major Issuers' Credit Card Spending in July Totaled NT$3332 Billion, Seasonal Decline, Citi Returns to Double Crown
paras: 國人消費動能持續強勁！國內五大發卡行最新揭曉的 2026 年 7 月信用卡財務數據顯示，受去年綜合所得稅延後至 7 月集中入帳造成比較基期較高影響，五大發卡行今年 7 月簽帳金額合計為 3,332 億元，較 6 月出現季節性回落，累計簽帳金額高達 2.45 兆元，年增 18.46%，各大行前 7 月均刷新歷年新高紀錄。而中信銀行重回單月「刷卡王」與「發卡王」寶座。
若與 6 月比較，因綜合所得稅刷卡繳稅效應衝高簽帳基期，各大銀行 7 月單月簽帳金額皆呈現月減趨勢。中國信託銀行 7 月信用卡簽帳金額達 903.55 億元，發卡量突破 10.9 萬張。主要成長動能來自稅費、旅遊、量販超商及海外消費。
國泰世華 7 月刷卡金額逾 803 億元，位居第二，排除綜所稅因素後，一般消費仍維持穩健成長，暑期海外旅遊、百貨購物及餐飲消費帶動顯著，值得注意的是，國泰世華單月爆出 47 萬張停卡量，主因國泰世華台塑聯名卡於今年 7 月 31 日合約屆期，並自 8月1日起停用，國泰世華改發 CUBE 信用卡，提供全新「台塑家」權益方案無縫接軌承接。
玉山銀行 7 月簽帳金額為 570.51 億元，主要受惠於暑假旅遊旺季帶動的國外實體消費，以及網購與行動支付的滲透率持續提升。台北富邦銀行 7 月簽帳金額達 550.15 億元，刷卡成長主力來自旅遊及量販賣場，兩者消費占比近 4 成。台新銀行 7 月刷卡金額達 504.60 億元，保費、海外與旅遊消費成長表現顯著。
從前 7 月的累計簽帳金額來看，五大發卡行表現極為亮眼，展現出台灣信用卡市場的強勁消費韌性。中信銀前 7 月信用卡簽帳金額達 6,457.36 億元(若含簽帳金融卡等總簽帳金額達 7,284 億元)，年增 24%，穩居市場領先地位。
國泰世華以 5,726.22 億元緊追在後，年成長 17%；玉山銀行以 4,705.47 億元居第三；台北富邦累計達 3,893.63 億元；台新銀行亦繳出 3,751.48 億元歷年新高的成績單。
展望下半年消費趨勢，各大銀行大多鎖定海外旅遊、數位消費及百貨週年慶等核心場景。中信銀深耕多元生態圈，針對暑假、開學季祭出涵蓋旅遊、美食保留位與演唱會優先購票等專屬回饋。
國泰世華聚焦 CUBE 平台的點數與數位服務生態圈，並隨著第四季 iPhone 新機上市、雙 11 與節慶檔期展開，預估將再迎一波消費高峰。玉山銀主打 Unicard 與熊本熊雙幣卡，結合精選超過 40 家旅行社與航空公司優惠，同步卡位中元節與下半年旅遊檔期。
北富銀鎖定中秋與雙十連假旅遊潮，提供海外藥妝、百貨與消費分期免息優惠，強化精準客群經營。台新銀則以 Richart 卡持續鎖定年輕族群的「Chill刷」聚會追星場景，並針對暑期與赴日旅遊提供最高 19% 等多元回饋加碼。
paras_en: Taiwanese consumer sentiment remains strong! The latest data from the five major issuers in 2026 shows that the total credit card spending in July was NT$3332 billion, a seasonal decline from June, but still a record high. The cumulative spending reached NT$2.45 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 18.46%. Each of the major banks has broken its previous record.

Compared to June, the single-month spending of the five major banks has decreased due to the effect of the delayed comprehensive income tax payment. CTBC Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$903.55 billion, with a record high of 109,000 new cards issued. The main growth drivers were tax, travel, convenience stores, and overseas consumption.

Cathay United Bank's credit card spending in July exceeded NT$803 billion, ranking second. Excluding the effect of comprehensive income tax, general consumption still maintained a steady growth. The summer overseas travel, department store purchases, and dining consumption drove significant growth. Notably, Cathay United Bank issued 470,000 new cards in July, mainly due to the expiration of the Taiwan Plastic Union card contract on July 31 and the subsequent discontinuation of the card on August 1. Cathay United Bank has replaced it with the CUBE credit card, offering a new 'Taiwan Plastic Family' benefits scheme.

Yuan-Tung Bank's credit card spending in July was NT$570.51 billion, mainly driven by the summer travel season and the increasing penetration of online shopping and mobile payments. Taipei Fubon Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$550.15 billion, with travel and convenience store consumption accounting for nearly 40% of the total. Taiwan Shin Kong Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$504.60 billion, with significant growth in insurance, overseas, and travel consumption.

Looking at the cumulative spending in the first seven months, the five major issuers have performed exceptionally well, demonstrating the resilience of Taiwan's credit card market. Citi's credit card spending in the first seven months reached NT$6,457.36 billion (NT$7,284 billion including credit card and debit card spending), a year-on-year increase of 24%, maintaining its market-leading position.

Cathay United Bank ranked second with NT$5,726.22 billion, a year-on-year increase of 17%. Yuan-Tung Bank ranked third with NT$4,705.47 billion. Taipei Fubon Bank's cumulative spending reached NT$3,893.63 billion, and Taiwan Shin Kong Bank's cumulative spending reached NT$3,751.48 billion, a new record high.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, most banks are focusing on overseas travel, digital consumption, and department store anniversary sales. Citi has deepened its multi-ecosystem, offering exclusive rewards for summer, back-to-school, and concert ticket purchases.

Cathay United Bank is focusing on the CUBE platform's points and digital service ecosystem. With the upcoming release of the new iPhone, Double 11, and holiday seasons, Cathay United Bank expects another wave of high consumption. Yuan-Tung Bank is promoting Unicard and the Bear Card, combining over 40 travel agencies and airlines' discounts, and synchronizing with the Mid-Autumn Festival and second-half travel seasons.

Taipei Fubon Bank is targeting the Mid-Autumn Festival and Double Ten holidays, offering overseas cosmetics, department store, and consumption installment-free benefits, and strengthening precise customer management. Taiwan Shin Kong Bank is continuing to target young consumers with the Richart card, focusing on 'Chill Swipe' gatherings and concert scenes, and offering up to 19% additional rewards for summer and Japan travel.

items.title: 為何9月是美股最慘月份？專家揭「南瓜拿鐵效應」 心理症狀引發季節性賣壓
items.title_en: Why September is the worst month for US stocks? Experts reveal the 'pumpkin spice latte effect'
paras: 9月一向是美股表現最弱的月份，MarketWatch專欄作家Mark Hulbert指出，投資人最好提高警覺：研究人員發現，隨著夏末到來，咖啡店開始大力促銷南瓜風味拿鐵時，消費者心情也隨著夏季將結束而日漸低迷，這可能導致股市跟著走弱。
根據道瓊市場數據分析，9月一向是美股報酬率表現最弱的月份。自道瓊工業平均指數在1890年代末創立以來，9月股市上漲的機率只有43%，其餘11個月份則為60%。不僅如此，9月平均報酬率為-1.1%，其他11個月份則平均上漲0.8%。這兩組平均值之間的差異，達到統計學95%信賴水準。
對投資人來說，9月是一年中表現最差月份這件事一直是個謎，統計學家也不斷提醒人們，在缺乏合理解釋的情況下，光憑歷史數據押注9月股市下跌的風險仍然太高。
Hulbert則指出，「南瓜香料拿鐵效應」或許可以提供部分解釋。
根據心理學家，在夏季轉入秋季時出現的低落情緒，是季節性情緒障礙(SAD)的一種表現。而SAD對股市有很大的影響，一項名為「季節性資產配置：來自共同基金資金流的證據」(Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows)的研究發現，股市與SAD之間存在強烈的反向關聯。
英屬哥倫比亞大學(UBC)憂鬱症研究教授Raymond Lam指出，SAD症狀通常與1月、2月等冬季月份相，但但真正影響股市的並不是SAD的絕對程度，而是SAD程度從這個月到下個月的變化，而8月到9月之間的變化，正好是全年最大的。
不過統計數據也顯示，這並不代表股市今年9月一定會表現糟糕，道瓊指數前兩個9月，都以上漲作收。可以確定的是，在一年12個月份中，9月是股市上漲機率最低的月份。
paras_en: September has always been the weakest month for US stocks, according to MarketWatch columnist Mark Hulbert. Investors should be on high alert: researchers found that as summer comes to an end, coffee shops aggressively promote pumpkin-flavored lattes, and consumers' moods also begin to decline, which may lead to a weaker stock market.

According to S&P 500 market data analysis, September has always been the worst-performing month for US stocks. Since the S&P 500 index was established in the late 19th century, the probability of the stock market rising in September is only 43%, while the other 11 months have a 60% chance. Moreover, the average return in September is -1.1%, while the other 11 months have an average return of 0.8%. The difference between these two sets of average values is statistically significant at the 95% confidence level.

For investors, the fact that September is the worst-performing month of the year has always been a mystery. Statisticians have repeatedly warned that relying solely on historical data to bet on a September stock market decline is still too high-risk, even without a clear explanation.
Hulbert suggests that the 'pumpkin spice latte effect' may provide some explanation.

According to psychologists, the low mood that appears when summer turns into autumn is a manifestation of seasonal affective disorder (SAD). SAD has a significant impact on the stock market, and a study titled 'Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows' found a strong inverse relationship between the stock market and SAD.

UBC professor of depression research Raymond Lam notes that SAD symptoms typically occur in January and February, but the real impact on the stock market is not the absolute level of SAD, but rather the change in SAD levels from one month to the next. The change from August to September is the largest of the year.

However, statistical data also shows that this does not mean that the stock market will definitely perform poorly in September this year. The S&P 500 index has risen in both of the past two Septembers. What is certain is that September has the lowest probability of a stock market rise among the 12 months of the year.

items.title: 摩根大通升評閃迪、目標價2250美元 股價噴漲逾7%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Upgrades Micron, Targets $2250, Stock Surges Over 7%
paras: 摩根大通 (小摩) 在閃迪 (SNDK-US) 舉行2026年投資人日後，將該股評級從「未評級」調升至「優於大盤」，並給予2027年12月目標價2,250美元。以週五收盤價計算，潛在上漲空間約37%。
閃迪週五 (14日) 飛升超7%，收每股1,641.11美元，盤後續漲1.09%至1,659.02美元，市值來到 2,396億美元。
分析師Harlan Sur指出，閃迪具備掌握AI推論帶動NAND需求成長的有利條件，升評理由主要包括長期供貨協議、NAND市場擴張及技術升級。
閃迪目前已簽署8份長期協議，按照最低價格計算，合約總值約940億美元，加權平均期限超過4年，即使以最低價格供貨，毛利率仍可達約80%。相關合約涵蓋的位元出貨占比，預計將由2027會計年度的逾50%，提高至2028會計年度的約三分之二。
Sur估計，全球NAND潛在市場規模將從2025年的約700億美元，增至2026年的逾3,000億美元，2027年更可能接近5,000億美元，主要受AI資料中心及推論需求帶動。
技術方面，閃迪新一代BiCS10已提前送樣，採用332層、2Tb QLC架構，每片晶圓可生產的位元數較前一代增加65%。公司同時布局高頻寬快閃記憶體，以掌握AI推論市場商機。
閃迪預計，2028至2030會計年度營收年增率可達百分之十幾的中高段，毛利率約80%，調整後自由現金流率約50%。摩根大通並估計，公司2027年每股盈餘可達250美元。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (small Morgan) upgraded Micron (SNDK-US) after its 2026 investor day, raising its rating to 'outperform' and setting a target price of $2,250 for December 2027. Based on Friday's closing price, the potential upside is approximately 37%.
Micron surged more than 7% on Friday (14th) to $1,641.11 per share, and rose 1.09% after hours to $1,659.02, with a market value of $239.6 billion.

Analyst Harlan Sur noted that Micron has favorable conditions to capture the growth of AI inference-driven NAND demand, with the main reasons for the upgrade including long-term supply agreements, NAND market expansion, and technology upgrades.

Micron has already signed eight long-term agreements, with a total value of approximately $94 billion at the lowest price, and a weighted average term of over four years. Even at the lowest price, the gross margin is expected to be around 80%. The contracts cover a bit more than 50% of the bit shipments in 2027, and are expected to increase to around two-thirds in 2028.

Sur estimates that the global NAND market size will increase from approximately $70 billion in 2025 to over $30 billion in 2026, and may approach $50 billion in 2027, mainly driven by AI data center and inference demand.

Technically, Micron's new generation BiCS10 has been sent out for sampling, using a 332-layer, 2Tb QLC architecture, with each wafer increasing the number of bits produced by 65% compared to the previous generation. The company is also laying out high-speed flash memory to capture the AI inference market opportunity.

Micron expects its revenue growth rate to be in the mid-to-high teens, around 15%, from 2028 to 2030, with a gross margin of around 80% and an adjusted free cash flow rate of around 50%. Morgan Stanley also estimates that the company's 2027 earnings per share will be $250.

items.title: 台積電董事會、MSCI台股權重三升、主計總處估今年GDP衝11.05% 本周大事回顧
paras: 台積電周二(11日)召開董事會，第二季配息維持7元，並宣布與索尼成立合資公司；MSCI周五(14日)公布最新季度調整，台股此次在三大指數權重全面調升；主計總處周五公布台灣最新GDP預測，預估今年將衝上11.05%，以下為本周大事回顧：
〈台積電董事會〉Q2配息維持7元 首次提供外資美元股利選擇
台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 周二 (11日) 召開董事會，共拍板四大議案，包括通過第二季財報、核准配發第二季現金股利 7 元、核准資本支出 294 億美元以及與索尼合資成立新公司，其中，第二季現金股利維持 7 元，預計 2026 年 12 月 10 日除息，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放，值得注意的是台積電本次股利發放開始提供外資股東美元股利的選擇。
另外，也宣布與索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony)簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司 Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於 2029 年開始量產。
〈MSCI調整〉台股權重三升8/31收盤生效 華邦電、南電等6檔入列標準指數
MSCI明晟周五(13日)公布最新季度調整，台股本次在三大指數權重全面調升，而 MSCI 台灣指數成份股中，南亞科(2408-TW)、華邦電(2344-TW)、群聯(8299-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)、景碩(3189-TW) 等 6 檔新增入列，最新權重將在8/31收盤生效。
主計總處估今年台灣GDP將衝上11.05% 創近40年來最高
主計總處周五(14日)公布今明年台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，由於上半年經濟成長14.15%，上修1.50個百分點，下半年預測成長8.27%，上修1.33個百分點，使全年GDP將衝上11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，創1988年以來最高紀錄，而消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率2.07%略高於台灣央行通膨警戒線2%。
〈鴻海法說〉Q3 AI機櫃出貨量估高雙位數季增 Vera Rubin Q4放量
鴻海(2317-TW)周三(12日)召開法說會，輪值CEO蔣集恆表示， AI機櫃出貨逐季成長的看法不變，第三季出貨量估高雙位數季增、全年維持倍數以上成長目標；輝達(NVDA-US)新一代AI平台Vera Rubin預計第四季放量出貨，將成為明年主力產品，AI伺服器市占率持續提高，朝50%目標邁進。
整體而言，第三季AI業務持續成長，加上ICT產品下半年進入旺季，預期整體營收強勁季、年增；全年也維持強勁成長看法，且在AI需求持續強勁下，正向看待明年。
〈廣達法說〉今年產能將較2025年翻倍 AI伺服器能見度看至2028年
廣達(2382-TW)周四(13日)公告最新財報並召開法說會，上半年稅後純益498.44億元，每股純益12.92元，創歷史新高。廣達指出，整體AI伺服器需求維持強勁，預期全年AI伺服器營收將倍增，且至今年底產能將翻倍，AI伺服器能見度已看至2028年。
台灣大斥資上限291億元、溢價29.5%收購精誠股權 目標持股過半
台灣大(3045-TW)周三(12日)召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。

items.title: 〈熱門股〉Gogolook下半年獲利更樂觀 漲近1成 反彈至1個月來高點
items.title_en: Gogolook Sees More Optimistic Second Half Earnings, Surging Nearly 10% to a One-Month High
paras: 信任科技服務商Gogolook(6902-TW)公布第二季稅後純益5961萬元，創單季獲利新高紀錄，每股純益(EPS)1.69元，並樂觀看待下半年獲利將持續強勁，本周股價漲近1成，周線終結連4黑，並回升至一個月來高點。
Gogolook表示，消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務同步擴張，今年全年營收有望續創新高，展望未來三年，策略重心將聚焦在加速 AI 創新、提升營運效率，以達成獲利的高速成長。
同時，為加速布局長期營收動能，Gogolook著眼企業端防詐以及以風控能力為核心的金融科技服務，主因企業端防詐的基期低且需求強勁，可望達成顯著成長，而金融科技服務不僅具備多元發展潛力，更能進一步拓展海內外商機。
Gogolook 共同創辦人暨董事長鄭勝丰表示，相信第二季不會是今年最好的一季，下半年更值得期待；隨著企業端服務陸續獲得政府機構與企業的肯定，長期訂單累積將加速未來的成長動能，尤其JUJI 招財麻吉在自研風控模型與國內金融機構保持高續約率，並陸續拓展至不同的應用場景下，第二季成功在泰國市場簽訂首筆企業訂單，可望加速當地市場的規模化。
paras_en: Gogolook (6902-TW), a trusted technology service provider, announced a net profit of NT$59.61 million in the second quarter, setting a new single-quarter profit record, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.69. The company is optimistic about its earnings in the second half of the year, with the stock price surging nearly 10% this week, ending a four-week losing streak and reaching a one-month high.

Gogolook stated that its three major businesses, including consumer protection, enterprise protection, and financial technology services, are expanding simultaneously. The company expects to achieve a new high in annual revenue this year and plans to focus its strategy on accelerating AI innovation and improving operational efficiency to achieve rapid growth in earnings over the next three years.

To accelerate its long-term revenue momentum, Gogolook is focusing on enterprise protection and financial technology services, with the latter being driven by its core wind control capabilities. The company believes that enterprise protection has a low base and strong demand, and is expected to achieve significant growth, while financial technology services have diverse development potential and can further expand business opportunities both domestically and internationally.

Gogolook co-founder and chairman Zheng Shengfeng expressed confidence that the second quarter will not be the best quarter of the year, and the second half will be more promising. As the company's enterprise services continue to gain recognition from government institutions and enterprises, long-term orders will accumulate, accelerating future growth momentum, particularly JUJI's self-developed wind control model, which has maintained a high renewal rate with domestic financial institutions and has expanded to various application scenarios. The company successfully signed its first enterprise order in the Thai market in the second quarter, which is expected to accelerate the market's scale-up.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉仁寶衝刺AI伺服器業務 外資狂敲逾10萬張周漲逾1成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Compal Accelerates AI Server Business, Foreign Investors Snap Up Over 100,000 Shares, Weekly Gain Over 10%
paras: 仁寶(2324-TW)衝刺AI伺服器業務，預期第三季伺服器業務季增高雙位數，且動能延續至第四季，全年伺服器營收占比可望達10%，力拚明年比重達30至40%，激勵仁寶本周漲逾1成，外資本周也大舉敲進仁寶超過10萬張。
仁寶本周漲18.19%，在周三(12日)及周五(14日)漲停，周五收43.2元，站回40元關卡，並站上所有均線。三大法人本周連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超11.88萬張，其中，外資也連3買，本周買超10.8萬張。
仁寶第二季伺服器營收占整體營收比重已提高至高個位數百分比，其中，在NeoCloud客戶帶動下，AI伺服器占整體伺服器營收達70%。仁寶指出，下半年伺服器動能維持強勁，全年伺服器營收比重有望達10%，明年更上看30至40%。
仁寶指出，目前客戶主要以NeoCloud為主，看好明年客戶組合將更多元，目標打入Tier 1、Hyperscale以及大型CSP。
為因應客戶強勁需求，仁寶同步擴充台灣、越南與美國產能。台灣方面，桃園大溪廠本周二(11日)啟用，主要為L10及L11的自動化生產，預期明年下半年就可滿載，鎖定NeoCloud客戶；越南廠則為仁寶L6在東南亞的主要生產基地，現階段有4條SMT產線，規劃新增6條，合計達10條，近期就會建置完成。
至於美國德州兩座新廠，預計今年底開始試產，明年第一季投產，未來可生產L6至L11產品，並服務Hyperscale及Enterprise企業級客戶，相關需求有望在今年底至明年初放量。
paras_en: Compal (2324-TW) is pushing into the AI server business, expecting double‑digit quarterly growth in server sales for Q3 that will carry into Q4, with server revenue projected to account for about 10% of total sales this year and aiming for 30‑40% next year. This optimism lifted Compal over 10% this week, and foreign investors aggressively bought more than 100,000 shares during the same period.

Compal rose 18.19% this week, hitting daily limits on Wednesday (12th) and Friday (14th) and closing at NT$43.2 on Friday, reclaiming the NT$40 level and moving above all moving averages. The three major institutional investors net‑bought for three consecutive trading days, totaling 118,800 shares this week, with foreign investors also buying for three straight days, netting 108,000 shares.

In Q2, server revenue’s share of Compal’s total sales rose to a high single‑digit percentage, and driven by NeoCloud customers, AI servers made up 70% of total server revenue. Compal said server momentum remains strong in the second half of the year, with the annual server revenue share expected to reach 10% and potentially 30‑40% next year.
Compal noted that its current customer base is mainly NeoCloud, but it expects a more diversified client mix next year, targeting Tier 1, hyperscale and large CSPs.

To meet strong customer demand, Compal is expanding capacity in Taiwan, Vietnam and the United States. In Taiwan, the Taoyuan Daxi plant started operations on Tuesday (11th) focusing on automated production of L10 and L11, expected to be fully utilized by the second half of next year for NeoCloud customers; the Vietnam plant, Compal’s main L6 production base in Southeast Asia, currently has four SMT lines and plans to add six more for a total of ten, with construction to be completed soon.

The two new factories in Texas, USA are slated to begin trial production by the end of this year and start full production in Q1 next year, capable of manufacturing L6 to L11 products and serving hyperscale and enterprise customers, with demand expected to ramp up from late this year into early next year.

items.title_en: <Hot Stock> Gigabyte Posts Q2 Profit of NT$6.6 Billion, Sets New Record; Stock Up 15% This Week, Foreign Investors Backed with Ten Consecutive Buys
paras: PC品牌技嘉(2376-TW)受惠AI伺服器出貨強勁，第二季與上半年獲利雙雙改寫歷史新高，本周買盤持續湧入，4日股價最高攻上402元，終場上漲4元，收在397.5元，本周股價累計強漲15.55%，周成交量59587張，其中外資已連十買，買超3.6萬張。
面對AI算力需求持續升溫，技嘉管理層表示下半年訂單能見度大幅提高，隨著客戶基礎設施建置與關鍵零組件供應改善，整體營收與營運成長力道將更勝上半年，因此將今年全年資本支出由原先的23億至25億元，進一步上修至28億至30億元，全力擴增伺服器廠房產能及機器設備。
在產業趨勢與新平台布局上，法人指出第二季雖為板卡傳統淡季且記憶體價格走揚，但技嘉在GB300伺服器機櫃放量下呈現淡季不淡，伺服器占整體營收比重持續攀升，加上輝達即將推出RTX SPARK超級電腦平台，技嘉預計明年首季推出相關新機種搶市，可望為下一波換機潮注入全新營運動能。
paras_en: Gigabyte (2376‑TW), a PC brand, benefited from strong AI server shipments, achieving record‑high profits for both Q2 and the first half of the year. Buying pressure kept flowing this week; on the 4th the stock peaked at NT$402, closed up NT$4 at NT$397.5, and rose a cumulative 15.55% for the week on a volume of 59,587 lots, with foreign investors buying for ten consecutive sessions and netting a purchase of 36,000 lots.

Facing sustained warming of AI compute demand, Gigabyte’s management said order visibility for the second half of the year has improved dramatically. With customers expanding infrastructure and key component supply easing, overall revenue and operating growth are expected to outpace the first half. Consequently, the company raised its full‑year capital expenditure target from the original NT$23‑25 billion to NT$28‑30 billion to fully expand server plant capacity and equipment.

Regarding industry trends and new platform positioning, analysts noted that although Q2 is traditionally a slow season for expansion cards and memory prices are rising, Gigabyte’s GB300 server chassis saw strong volume, keeping the season lively. The share of server revenue in total sales continues to climb, and with Nvidia set to launch the RTX SPARK supercomputer platform, Gigabyte plans to roll out related new models in Q1 next year, which could inject fresh operating momentum into the next wave of hardware upgrades.

items.title: 五大發卡行7月刷卡量3332億元季節性回落 中信銀重返雙冠王
items.title_en: Five Major Issuers' Credit Card Spending in July Totaled NT$3332 Billion, Seasonal Decline, Citi Returns to Double Crown
paras: 國人消費動能持續強勁！國內五大發卡行最新揭曉的 2026 年 7 月信用卡財務數據顯示，受去年綜合所得稅延後至 7 月集中入帳造成比較基期較高影響，五大發卡行今年 7 月簽帳金額合計為 3,332 億元，較 6 月出現季節性回落，累計簽帳金額高達 2.45 兆元，年增 18.46%，各大行前 7 月均刷新歷年新高紀錄。而中信銀行重回單月「刷卡王」與「發卡王」寶座。
若與 6 月比較，因綜合所得稅刷卡繳稅效應衝高簽帳基期，各大銀行 7 月單月簽帳金額皆呈現月減趨勢。中國信託銀行 7 月信用卡簽帳金額達 903.55 億元，發卡量突破 10.9 萬張。主要成長動能來自稅費、旅遊、量販超商及海外消費。
國泰世華 7 月刷卡金額逾 803 億元，位居第二，排除綜所稅因素後，一般消費仍維持穩健成長，暑期海外旅遊、百貨購物及餐飲消費帶動顯著，值得注意的是，國泰世華單月爆出 47 萬張停卡量，主因國泰世華台塑聯名卡於今年 7 月 31 日合約屆期，並自 8月1日起停用，國泰世華改發 CUBE 信用卡，提供全新「台塑家」權益方案無縫接軌承接。
玉山銀行 7 月簽帳金額為 570.51 億元，主要受惠於暑假旅遊旺季帶動的國外實體消費，以及網購與行動支付的滲透率持續提升。台北富邦銀行 7 月簽帳金額達 550.15 億元，刷卡成長主力來自旅遊及量販賣場，兩者消費占比近 4 成。台新銀行 7 月刷卡金額達 504.60 億元，保費、海外與旅遊消費成長表現顯著。
從前 7 月的累計簽帳金額來看，五大發卡行表現極為亮眼，展現出台灣信用卡市場的強勁消費韌性。中信銀前 7 月信用卡簽帳金額達 6,457.36 億元(若含簽帳金融卡等總簽帳金額達 7,284 億元)，年增 24%，穩居市場領先地位。
國泰世華以 5,726.22 億元緊追在後，年成長 17%；玉山銀行以 4,705.47 億元居第三；台北富邦累計達 3,893.63 億元；台新銀行亦繳出 3,751.48 億元歷年新高的成績單。
展望下半年消費趨勢，各大銀行大多鎖定海外旅遊、數位消費及百貨週年慶等核心場景。中信銀深耕多元生態圈，針對暑假、開學季祭出涵蓋旅遊、美食保留位與演唱會優先購票等專屬回饋。
國泰世華聚焦 CUBE 平台的點數與數位服務生態圈，並隨著第四季 iPhone 新機上市、雙 11 與節慶檔期展開，預估將再迎一波消費高峰。玉山銀主打 Unicard 與熊本熊雙幣卡，結合精選超過 40 家旅行社與航空公司優惠，同步卡位中元節與下半年旅遊檔期。
北富銀鎖定中秋與雙十連假旅遊潮，提供海外藥妝、百貨與消費分期免息優惠，強化精準客群經營。台新銀則以 Richart 卡持續鎖定年輕族群的「Chill刷」聚會追星場景，並針對暑期與赴日旅遊提供最高 19% 等多元回饋加碼。
paras_en: Taiwanese consumer sentiment remains strong! The latest data from the five major issuers in 2026 shows that the total credit card spending in July was NT$3332 billion, a seasonal decline from June, but still a record high. The cumulative spending reached NT$2.45 trillion, a year-on-year increase of 18.46%. Each of the major banks has broken its previous record.

Compared to June, the single-month spending of the five major banks has decreased due to the effect of the delayed comprehensive income tax payment. CTBC Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$903.55 billion, with a record high of 109,000 new cards issued. The main growth drivers were tax, travel, convenience stores, and overseas consumption.

Cathay United Bank's credit card spending in July exceeded NT$803 billion, ranking second. Excluding the effect of comprehensive income tax, general consumption still maintained a steady growth. The summer overseas travel, department store purchases, and dining consumption drove significant growth. Notably, Cathay United Bank issued 470,000 new cards in July, mainly due to the expiration of the Taiwan Plastic Union card contract on July 31 and the subsequent discontinuation of the card on August 1. Cathay United Bank has replaced it with the CUBE credit card, offering a new 'Taiwan Plastic Family' benefits scheme.

Yuan-Tung Bank's credit card spending in July was NT$570.51 billion, mainly driven by the summer travel season and the increasing penetration of online shopping and mobile payments. Taipei Fubon Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$550.15 billion, with travel and convenience store consumption accounting for nearly 40% of the total. Taiwan Shin Kong Bank's credit card spending in July reached NT$504.60 billion, with significant growth in insurance, overseas, and travel consumption.

Looking at the cumulative spending in the first seven months, the five major issuers have performed exceptionally well, demonstrating the resilience of Taiwan's credit card market. Citi's credit card spending in the first seven months reached NT$6,457.36 billion (NT$7,284 billion including credit card and debit card spending), a year-on-year increase of 24%, maintaining its market-leading position.

Cathay United Bank ranked second with NT$5,726.22 billion, a year-on-year increase of 17%. Yuan-Tung Bank ranked third with NT$4,705.47 billion. Taipei Fubon Bank's cumulative spending reached NT$3,893.63 billion, and Taiwan Shin Kong Bank's cumulative spending reached NT$3,751.48 billion, a new record high.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, most banks are focusing on overseas travel, digital consumption, and department store anniversary sales. Citi has deepened its multi-ecosystem, offering exclusive rewards for summer, back-to-school, and concert ticket purchases.

Cathay United Bank is focusing on the CUBE platform's points and digital service ecosystem. With the upcoming release of the new iPhone, Double 11, and holiday seasons, Cathay United Bank expects another wave of high consumption. Yuan-Tung Bank is promoting Unicard and the Bear Card, combining over 40 travel agencies and airlines' discounts, and synchronizing with the Mid-Autumn Festival and second-half travel seasons.

Taipei Fubon Bank is targeting the Mid-Autumn Festival and Double Ten holidays, offering overseas cosmetics, department store, and consumption installment-free benefits, and strengthening precise customer management. Taiwan Shin Kong Bank is continuing to target young consumers with the Richart card, focusing on 'Chill Swipe' gatherings and concert scenes, and offering up to 19% additional rewards for summer and Japan travel.

items.title: 台積電董事會、MSCI台股權重三升、主計總處估今年GDP衝11.05% 本周大事回顧
paras: 台積電周二(11日)召開董事會，第二季配息維持7元，並宣布與索尼成立合資公司；MSCI周五(14日)公布最新季度調整，台股此次在三大指數權重全面調升；主計總處周五公布台灣最新GDP預測，預估今年將衝上11.05%，以下為本周大事回顧：
〈台積電董事會〉Q2配息維持7元 首次提供外資美元股利選擇
台積電 (2330-TW)(TSM-US) 周二 (11日) 召開董事會，共拍板四大議案，包括通過第二季財報、核准配發第二季現金股利 7 元、核准資本支出 294 億美元以及與索尼合資成立新公司，其中，第二季現金股利維持 7 元，預計 2026 年 12 月 10 日除息，並於 2027 年 1 月 7 日發放，值得注意的是台積電本次股利發放開始提供外資股東美元股利的選擇。
另外，也宣布與索尼半導體解決方案公司 (Sony)簽署具法律效力之最終合作協議，於日本熊本縣合志市成立合資公司 Advanced Vision Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation。此合資公司將採用先進製程技術，作為量產智慧型手機影像感測器所需之研發及製造的核心樞紐，並預計於 2029 年開始量產。
〈MSCI調整〉台股權重三升8/31收盤生效 華邦電、南電等6檔入列標準指數
MSCI明晟周五(13日)公布最新季度調整，台股本次在三大指數權重全面調升，而 MSCI 台灣指數成份股中，南亞科(2408-TW)、華邦電(2344-TW)、群聯(8299-TW)、南電(8046-TW)、台燿(6274-TW)、景碩(3189-TW) 等 6 檔新增入列，最新權重將在8/31收盤生效。
主計總處估今年台灣GDP將衝上11.05% 創近40年來最高
主計總處周五(14日)公布今明年台灣經濟成長率(GDP)最新預測值，由於上半年經濟成長14.15%，上修1.50個百分點，下半年預測成長8.27%，上修1.33個百分點，使全年GDP將衝上11.05%，上修1.41個百分點，創1988年以來最高紀錄，而消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率2.07%略高於台灣央行通膨警戒線2%。
〈鴻海法說〉Q3 AI機櫃出貨量估高雙位數季增 Vera Rubin Q4放量
鴻海(2317-TW)周三(12日)召開法說會，輪值CEO蔣集恆表示， AI機櫃出貨逐季成長的看法不變，第三季出貨量估高雙位數季增、全年維持倍數以上成長目標；輝達(NVDA-US)新一代AI平台Vera Rubin預計第四季放量出貨，將成為明年主力產品，AI伺服器市占率持續提高，朝50%目標邁進。
整體而言，第三季AI業務持續成長，加上ICT產品下半年進入旺季，預期整體營收強勁季、年增；全年也維持強勁成長看法，且在AI需求持續強勁下，正向看待明年。
〈廣達法說〉今年產能將較2025年翻倍 AI伺服器能見度看至2028年
廣達(2382-TW)周四(13日)公告最新財報並召開法說會，上半年稅後純益498.44億元，每股純益12.92元，創歷史新高。廣達指出，整體AI伺服器需求維持強勁，預期全年AI伺服器營收將倍增，且至今年底產能將翻倍，AI伺服器能見度已看至2028年。
台灣大斥資上限291億元、溢價29.5%收購精誠股權 目標持股過半
台灣大(3045-TW)周三(12日)召開重訊記者會，宣布將透過全資子公司「台信電訊」公開收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)普通股，目標增持至少39%，總持股將過半，全案收購價金上限達291.3億元。總經理林之晨指出，對於此次收購所產生的綜效具高度信心，取得過半股權後，最快今年可大幅提升雙方營收與獲利。

items.title: 〈熱門股〉Gogolook下半年獲利更樂觀 漲近1成 反彈至1個月來高點
items.title_en: Gogolook Sees More Optimistic Second Half Earnings, Surging Nearly 10% to a One-Month High
paras: 信任科技服務商Gogolook(6902-TW)公布第二季稅後純益5961萬元，創單季獲利新高紀錄，每股純益(EPS)1.69元，並樂觀看待下半年獲利將持續強勁，本周股價漲近1成，周線終結連4黑，並回升至一個月來高點。
Gogolook表示，消費者防詐、企業端防詐和金融科技服務等三大業務同步擴張，今年全年營收有望續創新高，展望未來三年，策略重心將聚焦在加速 AI 創新、提升營運效率，以達成獲利的高速成長。
同時，為加速布局長期營收動能，Gogolook著眼企業端防詐以及以風控能力為核心的金融科技服務，主因企業端防詐的基期低且需求強勁，可望達成顯著成長，而金融科技服務不僅具備多元發展潛力，更能進一步拓展海內外商機。
Gogolook 共同創辦人暨董事長鄭勝丰表示，相信第二季不會是今年最好的一季，下半年更值得期待；隨著企業端服務陸續獲得政府機構與企業的肯定，長期訂單累積將加速未來的成長動能，尤其JUJI 招財麻吉在自研風控模型與國內金融機構保持高續約率，並陸續拓展至不同的應用場景下，第二季成功在泰國市場簽訂首筆企業訂單，可望加速當地市場的規模化。
paras_en: Gogolook (6902-TW), a trusted technology service provider, announced a net profit of NT$59.61 million in the second quarter, setting a new single-quarter profit record, with earnings per share (EPS) of NT$1.69. The company is optimistic about its earnings in the second half of the year, with the stock price surging nearly 10% this week, ending a four-week losing streak and reaching a one-month high.

Gogolook stated that its three major businesses, including consumer protection, enterprise protection, and financial technology services, are expanding simultaneously. The company expects to achieve a new high in annual revenue this year and plans to focus its strategy on accelerating AI innovation and improving operational efficiency to achieve rapid growth in earnings over the next three years.

To accelerate its long-term revenue momentum, Gogolook is focusing on enterprise protection and financial technology services, with the latter being driven by its core wind control capabilities. The company believes that enterprise protection has a low base and strong demand, and is expected to achieve significant growth, while financial technology services have diverse development potential and can further expand business opportunities both domestically and internationally.

Gogolook co-founder and chairman Zheng Shengfeng expressed confidence that the second quarter will not be the best quarter of the year, and the second half will be more promising. As the company's enterprise services continue to gain recognition from government institutions and enterprises, long-term orders will accumulate, accelerating future growth momentum, particularly JUJI's self-developed wind control model, which has maintained a high renewal rate with domestic financial institutions and has expanded to various application scenarios. The company successfully signed its first enterprise order in the Thai market in the second quarter, which is expected to accelerate the market's scale-up.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉仁寶衝刺AI伺服器業務 外資狂敲逾10萬張周漲逾1成
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Compal Accelerates AI Server Business, Foreign Investors Snap Up Over 100,000 Shares, Weekly Gain Over 10%
paras: 仁寶(2324-TW)衝刺AI伺服器業務，預期第三季伺服器業務季增高雙位數，且動能延續至第四季，全年伺服器營收占比可望達10%，力拚明年比重達30至40%，激勵仁寶本周漲逾1成，外資本周也大舉敲進仁寶超過10萬張。
仁寶本周漲18.19%，在周三(12日)及周五(14日)漲停，周五收43.2元，站回40元關卡，並站上所有均線。三大法人本周連續3個交易日買超，本周合計買超11.88萬張，其中，外資也連3買，本周買超10.8萬張。
仁寶第二季伺服器營收占整體營收比重已提高至高個位數百分比，其中，在NeoCloud客戶帶動下，AI伺服器占整體伺服器營收達70%。仁寶指出，下半年伺服器動能維持強勁，全年伺服器營收比重有望達10%，明年更上看30至40%。
仁寶指出，目前客戶主要以NeoCloud為主，看好明年客戶組合將更多元，目標打入Tier 1、Hyperscale以及大型CSP。
為因應客戶強勁需求，仁寶同步擴充台灣、越南與美國產能。台灣方面，桃園大溪廠本周二(11日)啟用，主要為L10及L11的自動化生產，預期明年下半年就可滿載，鎖定NeoCloud客戶；越南廠則為仁寶L6在東南亞的主要生產基地，現階段有4條SMT產線，規劃新增6條，合計達10條，近期就會建置完成。
至於美國德州兩座新廠，預計今年底開始試產，明年第一季投產，未來可生產L6至L11產品，並服務Hyperscale及Enterprise企業級客戶，相關需求有望在今年底至明年初放量。
paras_en: Compal (2324-TW) is pushing into the AI server business, expecting double‑digit quarterly growth in server sales for Q3 that will carry into Q4, with server revenue projected to account for about 10% of total sales this year and aiming for 30‑40% next year. This optimism lifted Compal over 10% this week, and foreign investors aggressively bought more than 100,000 shares during the same period.

Compal rose 18.19% this week, hitting daily limits on Wednesday (12th) and Friday (14th) and closing at NT$43.2 on Friday, reclaiming the NT$40 level and moving above all moving averages. The three major institutional investors net‑bought for three consecutive trading days, totaling 118,800 shares this week, with foreign investors also buying for three straight days, netting 108,000 shares.

In Q2, server revenue’s share of Compal’s total sales rose to a high single‑digit percentage, and driven by NeoCloud customers, AI servers made up 70% of total server revenue. Compal said server momentum remains strong in the second half of the year, with the annual server revenue share expected to reach 10% and potentially 30‑40% next year.
Compal noted that its current customer base is mainly NeoCloud, but it expects a more diversified client mix next year, targeting Tier 1, hyperscale and large CSPs.

To meet strong customer demand, Compal is expanding capacity in Taiwan, Vietnam and the United States. In Taiwan, the Taoyuan Daxi plant started operations on Tuesday (11th) focusing on automated production of L10 and L11, expected to be fully utilized by the second half of next year for NeoCloud customers; the Vietnam plant, Compal’s main L6 production base in Southeast Asia, currently has four SMT lines and plans to add six more for a total of ten, with construction to be completed soon.

The two new factories in Texas, USA are slated to begin trial production by the end of this year and start full production in Q1 next year, capable of manufacturing L6 to L11 products and serving hyperscale and enterprise customers, with demand expected to ramp up from late this year into early next year.

items.title: OpenAI財務長：企業營收已超越消費者業務
items.title_en: OpenAI CFO: Enterprise Revenue Exceeds Consumer Business
paras: 《CNBC》報導，在OpenAI高層經歷動盪的一周後，財務長Sarah Friar周五(14日)與投資人舉行會議，強調公司企業業務的成長。她表示，目前企業業務的營收已超越以ChatGPT為主的消費者業務。
一名出席會議的知情人士透露，Friar在會中表示，「我們今年初的比例是60比40，但企業業務成長速度遠超預期，如今兩者的比例已經交叉。目前我們大部分的營收都來自企業業務。」
這代表OpenAI的企業業務成長已超越先前預期。Friar今年稍早接受CNBC採訪時曾表示，公司原本預期這兩項業務將在2026年底達到相當規模。OpenAI目前的年化營收規模已達400億美元。
根據CNBC看到的簡報資料，OpenAI的年化營收7月較前一個月增加20%，企業客戶營收成長速度更快，增加32%。
知情人士表示，周五的投資人會議在本周高層離職事件發生前就已安排，參與者為OpenAI現有股東。會議舉行前一天，營收長Denise Dresser宣布離職，上任僅8個月。Dresser曾在Salesforce(CRM-US)任職超過10年，最近則擔任Slack執行長。她在LinkedIn發文表示，將離開公司尋求其他發展機會。
兩天前，OpenAI資深高層Brad Lightcap也宣布結束自己在這家ChatGPT開發商長達8年的任期。
OpenAI總裁兼共同創辦人Greg Brockman也參加了周五的會議。知情人士表示，Brockman感謝Dresser對公司的貢獻，以及她為企業業務奠定的基礎，並對接替她的Dali Rajic表示期待。Rajic此前擔任網路安全公司Wiz的營運長，Wiz目前已由Google(GOOGL-US)收購。
知情人士透露，Rajic是透過Thrive創辦人Josh Kushner的介紹加入OpenAI。
與會高層也被問及中國開源模型崛起所帶來的競爭。知情人士表示，Brockman淡化了這項競爭威脅，並指出市場對「開源模型比較便宜」存在誤解。
高層也被問到公司何時可能進行首次公開募股(IPO)。但由於OpenAI已向美國證券管理委員會(SEC)提交機密文件，管理層無法對此談論。
Friar在會中強調營收成長，並表示公司正在因應客戶使用方式的改變。所謂的「狂燒Token」(tokenmaxxing)時代已經過去，也就是企業不再允許員工在沒有展現足夠產出的情況下，無限制累積龐大的AI支出。
知情人士引述Friar的說法指出，「企業客戶已經從狂燒Token轉向關注每單位智慧的成本。」她並強調，OpenAI最新模型在代理型程式設計任務上的效率提高54%，同時公司近期也下調了旗下模型系列的價格。
Friar也表示，OpenAI在廣告業務方面「取得重大進展」。該名知情人士指出，OpenAI廣告業務的年化營收規模已接近10億美元。OpenAI今年2月開始在ChatGPT測試廣告。
paras_en: CNBC reported that OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar held a meeting with investors on Friday (14th) after a week of turmoil among the company's top executives, emphasizing the growth of the company's enterprise business. She stated that the current revenue of the enterprise business has surpassed that of the consumer business led by ChatGPT.

A source who attended the meeting revealed that Friar stated in the meeting, "We were at 60-40 at the beginning of this year, but the growth rate of the enterprise business far exceeded our expectations, and now the two have crossed over. Most of our revenue now comes from the enterprise business."

This represents that OpenAI's enterprise business has grown beyond previous expectations. Friar had previously stated in an interview with CNBC that the company expected the two businesses to reach a similar scale by the end of 2026. OpenAI's annual revenue has now reached $40 billion.

According to the presentation materials seen by CNBC, OpenAI's annual revenue increased by 20% in July compared to the previous month, with enterprise customer revenue growth even faster, increasing by 32%.

The source stated that the investor meeting on Friday had been scheduled before the high-level departure event this week, and the participants were existing shareholders of OpenAI. The day before the meeting, revenue chief Denise Dresser announced her resignation, having been in office for only 8 months. Dresser had worked at Salesforce (CRM-US) for over 10 years and had recently served as the CEO of Slack. She stated on LinkedIn that she would be leaving the company to seek new development opportunities.
Two days ago, OpenAI's senior executive Brad Lightcap also announced the end of his 8-year tenure at the company, which developed ChatGPT.

OpenAI CEO and co-founder Greg Brockman also attended the meeting on Friday. The source stated that Brockman thanked Dresser for her contributions to the company and the foundation she laid for the enterprise business, and expressed his expectations for her replacement, Dali Rajic. Rajic had previously served as the operating chief of network security company Wiz, which was acquired by Google (GOOGL-US).
The source revealed that Rajic was introduced to OpenAI through Thrive founder Josh Kushner.

The attending executives were also asked about the competition brought by the rise of open-source models in China. The source stated that Brockman downplayed the threat of this competition and pointed out that the market had a misconception about the cost-effectiveness of open-source models.

The executives were also asked when the company might conduct its initial public offering (IPO). However, since OpenAI had submitted confidential documents to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the management team was unable to discuss this.

Friar emphasized revenue growth in the meeting and stated that the company is responding to changes in customer usage patterns. The "tokenmaxxing" era is over, meaning that companies no longer allow employees to accumulate large AI expenses without demonstrating sufficient output.

The source quoted Friar as saying, "Enterprise customers have moved from tokenmaxxing to focusing on the cost of each unit of intelligence." She emphasized that OpenAI's latest model has improved efficiency by 54% in proxy programming tasks, and the company has recently reduced the prices of its model series.

Friar also stated that OpenAI has made "significant progress" in its advertising business. The source stated that OpenAI's annual revenue from advertising has reached nearly $1 billion. OpenAI began testing advertising on ChatGPT in February this year.

items.title: 為何9月是美股最慘月份？專家揭「南瓜拿鐵效應」 心理症狀引發季節性賣壓
items.title_en: Why September is the worst month for US stocks? Experts reveal the 'pumpkin spice latte effect'
paras: 9月一向是美股表現最弱的月份，MarketWatch專欄作家Mark Hulbert指出，投資人最好提高警覺：研究人員發現，隨著夏末到來，咖啡店開始大力促銷南瓜風味拿鐵時，消費者心情也隨著夏季將結束而日漸低迷，這可能導致股市跟著走弱。
根據道瓊市場數據分析，9月一向是美股報酬率表現最弱的月份。自道瓊工業平均指數在1890年代末創立以來，9月股市上漲的機率只有43%，其餘11個月份則為60%。不僅如此，9月平均報酬率為-1.1%，其他11個月份則平均上漲0.8%。這兩組平均值之間的差異，達到統計學95%信賴水準。
對投資人來說，9月是一年中表現最差月份這件事一直是個謎，統計學家也不斷提醒人們，在缺乏合理解釋的情況下，光憑歷史數據押注9月股市下跌的風險仍然太高。
Hulbert則指出，「南瓜香料拿鐵效應」或許可以提供部分解釋。
根據心理學家，在夏季轉入秋季時出現的低落情緒，是季節性情緒障礙(SAD)的一種表現。而SAD對股市有很大的影響，一項名為「季節性資產配置：來自共同基金資金流的證據」(Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows)的研究發現，股市與SAD之間存在強烈的反向關聯。
英屬哥倫比亞大學(UBC)憂鬱症研究教授Raymond Lam指出，SAD症狀通常與1月、2月等冬季月份相，但但真正影響股市的並不是SAD的絕對程度，而是SAD程度從這個月到下個月的變化，而8月到9月之間的變化，正好是全年最大的。
不過統計數據也顯示，這並不代表股市今年9月一定會表現糟糕，道瓊指數前兩個9月，都以上漲作收。可以確定的是，在一年12個月份中，9月是股市上漲機率最低的月份。
paras_en: September has always been the weakest month for US stocks, according to MarketWatch columnist Mark Hulbert. Investors should be on high alert: researchers found that as summer comes to an end, coffee shops aggressively promote pumpkin-flavored lattes, and consumers' moods also begin to decline, which may lead to a weaker stock market.

According to S&P 500 market data analysis, September has always been the worst-performing month for US stocks. Since the S&P 500 index was established in the late 19th century, the probability of the stock market rising in September is only 43%, while the other 11 months have a 60% chance. Moreover, the average return in September is -1.1%, while the other 11 months have an average return of 0.8%. The difference between these two sets of average values is statistically significant at the 95% confidence level.

For investors, the fact that September is the worst-performing month of the year has always been a mystery. Statisticians have repeatedly warned that relying solely on historical data to bet on a September stock market decline is still too high-risk, even without a clear explanation.
Hulbert suggests that the 'pumpkin spice latte effect' may provide some explanation.

According to psychologists, the low mood that appears when summer turns into autumn is a manifestation of seasonal affective disorder (SAD). SAD has a significant impact on the stock market, and a study titled 'Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows' found a strong inverse relationship between the stock market and SAD.

UBC professor of depression research Raymond Lam notes that SAD symptoms typically occur in January and February, but the real impact on the stock market is not the absolute level of SAD, but rather the change in SAD levels from one month to the next. The change from August to September is the largest of the year.

However, statistical data also shows that this does not mean that the stock market will definitely perform poorly in September this year. The S&P 500 index has risen in both of the past two Septembers. What is certain is that September has the lowest probability of a stock market rise among the 12 months of the year.

items.title: 摩根大通升評閃迪、目標價2250美元 股價噴漲逾7%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Upgrades Micron, Targets $2250, Stock Surges Over 7%
paras: 摩根大通 (小摩) 在閃迪 (SNDK-US) 舉行2026年投資人日後，將該股評級從「未評級」調升至「優於大盤」，並給予2027年12月目標價2,250美元。以週五收盤價計算，潛在上漲空間約37%。
閃迪週五 (14日) 飛升超7%，收每股1,641.11美元，盤後續漲1.09%至1,659.02美元，市值來到 2,396億美元。
分析師Harlan Sur指出，閃迪具備掌握AI推論帶動NAND需求成長的有利條件，升評理由主要包括長期供貨協議、NAND市場擴張及技術升級。
閃迪目前已簽署8份長期協議，按照最低價格計算，合約總值約940億美元，加權平均期限超過4年，即使以最低價格供貨，毛利率仍可達約80%。相關合約涵蓋的位元出貨占比，預計將由2027會計年度的逾50%，提高至2028會計年度的約三分之二。
Sur估計，全球NAND潛在市場規模將從2025年的約700億美元，增至2026年的逾3,000億美元，2027年更可能接近5,000億美元，主要受AI資料中心及推論需求帶動。
技術方面，閃迪新一代BiCS10已提前送樣，採用332層、2Tb QLC架構，每片晶圓可生產的位元數較前一代增加65%。公司同時布局高頻寬快閃記憶體，以掌握AI推論市場商機。
閃迪預計，2028至2030會計年度營收年增率可達百分之十幾的中高段，毛利率約80%，調整後自由現金流率約50%。摩根大通並估計，公司2027年每股盈餘可達250美元。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (small Morgan) upgraded Micron (SNDK-US) after its 2026 investor day, raising its rating to 'outperform' and setting a target price of $2,250 for December 2027. Based on Friday's closing price, the potential upside is approximately 37%.
Micron surged more than 7% on Friday (14th) to $1,641.11 per share, and rose 1.09% after hours to $1,659.02, with a market value of $239.6 billion.

Analyst Harlan Sur noted that Micron has favorable conditions to capture the growth of AI inference-driven NAND demand, with the main reasons for the upgrade including long-term supply agreements, NAND market expansion, and technology upgrades.

Micron has already signed eight long-term agreements, with a total value of approximately $94 billion at the lowest price, and a weighted average term of over four years. Even at the lowest price, the gross margin is expected to be around 80%. The contracts cover a bit more than 50% of the bit shipments in 2027, and are expected to increase to around two-thirds in 2028.

Sur estimates that the global NAND market size will increase from approximately $70 billion in 2025 to over $30 billion in 2026, and may approach $50 billion in 2027, mainly driven by AI data center and inference demand.

Technically, Micron's new generation BiCS10 has been sent out for sampling, using a 332-layer, 2Tb QLC architecture, with each wafer increasing the number of bits produced by 65% compared to the previous generation. The company is also laying out high-speed flash memory to capture the AI inference market opportunity.

Micron expects its revenue growth rate to be in the mid-to-high teens, around 15%, from 2028 to 2030, with a gross margin of around 80% and an adjusted free cash flow rate of around 50%. Morgan Stanley also estimates that the company's 2027 earnings per share will be $250.

items.title: 中國版Apple Intelligence技術路線曝光！核心不用Gemini、改採蘋果自研模型
items.title_en: China Version of Apple Intelligence Technology Roadmap Revealed! Core Not Gemini, Uses Apple’s Own Model
paras: 蘋果正為Apple Intelligence進入中國市場採取不同於海外市場的技術路線。據《路透社》報導，中國版Apple Intelligence將以蘋果自行訓練的大型語言模型為核心，而非直接採用Google Gemini或阿里巴巴的通義千問(Qwen)。
這套模型由蘋果與阿里巴巴合作訓練。雖然主要大型語言模型仍由蘋果主導，但Qwen預計也會以某種形式整合至中國市場銷售的蘋果 (AAPL-US) 裝置，百度的相關技術同樣可能被納入。
這項安排與蘋果在美國等市場的策略有所不同。
海外版Apple Intelligence雖然擁有蘋果自家的基礎模型，但部分進階功能會採用Google Gemini技術，Siri也能透過擴充功能連接OpenAI的ChatGPT。由於Gemini、ChatGPT及Anthropic旗下Claude目前均無法在中國提供服務，蘋果必須另行建立符合當地法規的技術架構。
中國AI法規複雜 蘋果必須借助本土業者
中國對生成式AI服務實施嚴格監管，外國科技公司若要在當地推出相關產品，實際上通常需要與中國企業合作。蘋果因此攜手阿里巴巴，同時導入Qwen及百度技術，以滿足模型訓練、內容審查與監管合規等要求。
先前報導指出，阿里巴巴可能負責中國版Apple Intelligence的內容審查機制，相關限制預料也會同時適用於蘋果自研模型及Qwen提供的功能。
中國監管機關近期已批准Apple Intelligence在當地使用，但服務尚未正式推出，後續仍可能面臨其他監管程序。若最終順利上線，蘋果可望成為率先在中國推出自有AI模型的外國科技公司之一。
上線準備疑似接近完成 蘋果仍未公布時間
蘋果目前尚未公布中國版Apple Intelligence的確切推出日期，但多項跡象顯示相關準備工作已進入後期。今年3月，這項服務一度短暫在中國市場開放，外界推測可能是意外提前上線，也反映技術部署已大致完成。
此外，蘋果支援網站近期曾發布在Mac上使用Qwen的操作指南，隨後又將文件撤下，進一步引發外界對雙方合作即將落地的猜測。
中國長期以來一直是蘋果的重要市場。儘管iPhone過去數年在當地銷售一度明顯下滑，但近期情況已有改善，iPhone 17系列在中國的市場表現更優於蘋果原先預期。Apple Intelligence若能順利推出，可望成為蘋果維持中國市場成長動能的重要一環。
paras_en: Apple is taking a different technical approach for Apple Intelligence in the Chinese market compared to overseas markets. According to Reuters, the China version of Apple Intelligence will be built around a large language model trained by Apple itself, rather than directly using Google Gemini or Alibaba’s Tongyi Qwen.

The model is being trained in collaboration between Apple and Alibaba. While the primary large language model remains Apple‑led, Qwen is expected to be integrated in some form into Apple (AAPL‑US) devices sold in China, and Baidu’s related technology may also be incorporated.
This arrangement differs from Apple’s strategy in the United States and other markets.

The overseas version of Apple Intelligence, although based on Apple’s own foundational model, uses Google Gemini for some advanced features, and Siri can connect to OpenAI’s ChatGPT via extensions. Because Gemini, ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude are currently unavailable in China, Apple must build a separate technical architecture that complies with local regulations.
China’s AI regulations are complex; Apple must rely on domestic partners

China imposes strict oversight on generative AI services, and foreign tech firms typically need to partner with Chinese companies to launch such products locally. Consequently, Apple is teaming up with Alibaba and also bringing in Qwen and Baidu technologies to meet requirements for model training, content moderation and regulatory compliance.

Earlier reports indicated that Alibaba may handle the content‑review mechanism for the China version of Apple Intelligence, and the related restrictions are expected to apply to both Apple’s own model and the functions provided by Qwen.

Chinese regulators have recently approved the use of Apple Intelligence in the country, but the service has not yet been officially launched and may still face additional regulatory steps. If it goes live smoothly, Apple could become one of the first foreign tech companies to launch its own AI model in China.
Launch preparations appear to be nearing completion, but Apple has not announced a timeline

Apple has not disclosed a specific rollout date for the China version of Apple Intelligence, yet several signs suggest that preparations are in the final stages. In March this year the service was briefly opened in the Chinese market, which observers think may have been an accidental early launch and indicates that the technical deployment is largely finished.
In addition, Apple’s support site recently posted a guide on using Qwen on Mac, then removed the document, further fueling speculation that the partnership is about to be realized.

China has long been a key market for Apple. Although iPhone sales in the country had noticeably declined in recent years, the situation has improved lately, with the iPhone 17 series performing better in China than Apple originally expected. If Apple Intelligence is successfully launched, it could become an important driver for sustaining Apple’s growth momentum in the Chinese market.

items.title: 上市前關鍵里程碑！Anthropic Q2營收暴增為14倍 調整後營業利益首度轉正
items.title_en: IPO Milestone! Anthropic Q2 Revenue Surges 14-Fold, Adjusted Profit Turns Positive
paras: Anthropic向潛在投資人表示，第2季營收暴增為至少去年同期的14倍，不僅如此，調整後營業利益已經轉正，象徵該公司在衝刺首次公開發行(IPO)階段所達到的一個關鍵營運里程碑。
根據彭博取得的文件，Anthropic第2季的初步營收超過115億美元，高於2025年同期的7.87億美元，也較今年第1季的47.3億美元大幅成長。這份文件還顯示，Anthropic在今年第2季的調整後營業利益已經轉正。
截至5月，Anthropic的年化營收預估值已突破470億美元，主要受惠於企業專業人士採用率持續攀升。
這波快速擴張凸顯Anthropic與長期競爭對手OpenAI之間的競爭日益白熱化。根據近期報導，OpenAI的年化營收預估值已超過400億美元，儘管兩家公司計算的方式可能不同，但這些數據仍顯示，隨著企業客戶加速增加人工智慧(AI)支出，企業AI市場的競爭正變得更加激烈。
Anthropic據悉今年秋季可能發動超大型IPO，目前正積極與潛在投資人會面，討論公司未來的財務發展。據悉Anthropic已秘密提交IPO申請，並與摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)、高盛(Goldman Sachs)及摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)的顧問團隊合作籌備上市案。
如果Anthropic今年秋季IPO，上市時間將不僅早於OpenAI，也可能早於中國AI業者DeepSeek。DeepSeek近來正逐步搶占AI技術市場版圖占知情人士透露，該公司正在準備IPO，最快可能今年就提交上市申請。
AI競賽也點燃IPO市場熱度。根據彭博彙整的數據，不包括特殊目的收購公司(SPAC)及其他金融工具，今年以來IPO募集資金已達2564億美元，這將是2021年以來IPO募資金額最高的一年。
paras_en: Anthropic has informed potential investors that its second-quarter revenue has surged at least 14 times that of the same period last year, not only that, but its adjusted profit has turned positive, marking a crucial operational milestone for the company as it gears up for its initial public offering (IPO).

According to a document obtained by Bloomberg, Anthropic's preliminary second-quarter revenue exceeded $11.5 billion, surpassing $787 million in the same period last year and significantly growing from $4.73 billion in the first quarter of this year. The document also shows that Anthropic's adjusted profit has turned positive in the second quarter of this year.
As of May, Anthropic's annualized revenue estimate has broken through $47 billion, mainly driven by the continued increase in adoption rates among corporate professionals.

This rapid expansion highlights the intensifying competition between Anthropic and its long-term rival OpenAI. According to recent reports, OpenAI's annualized revenue estimate has exceeded $40 billion, despite the possible differences in calculation methods, these data still show that as corporate clients accelerate their spending on artificial intelligence (AI), the competition in the enterprise AI market is becoming increasingly fierce.

Anthropic is reportedly planning to launch a massive IPO in the fall of this year, actively meeting with potential investors to discuss the company's future financial development. It is said that Anthropic has secretly submitted an IPO application and is working with a team of advisors from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan Chase to prepare for the listing.

If Anthropic goes public in the fall of this year, its listing time will not only be earlier than OpenAI's, but it may also be earlier than that of Chinese AI player DeepSeek. DeepSeek is currently gradually occupying the map of AI technology market shares, insiders revealed that the company is preparing for an IPO, which may submit a listing application as early as this year.

The AI competition has also ignited the IPO market's enthusiasm. According to data compiled by Bloomberg, excluding special-purpose acquisition companies (SPACs) and other financial instruments, the total amount of IPO fundraising this year has reached $256.4 billion, which will be the highest IPO fundraising amount since 2021.

items.title: 川普祭無人機100%重稅 無人機股全面升空
paras: 川普政府宣布對外國製無人機及關鍵零組件加徵新關稅，藉此降低美國對中國供應鏈的依賴，並加速擴充本土產能。政策消息帶動美國無人機及國防類股週五 (14 日) 全面走高，Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) 強勢噴高逾24%，成為市場焦點。
根據白宮公布的措施，具備熱成像等軍事敏感功能的大型無人機，以及被認定為關鍵的無人機零組件，將面臨100%關稅；小型無人機及敏感程度較低的零組件則適用25%稅率。
日本、英國等特定國家的產品可適用較低稅率。多數新關稅預計於9月生效，至於敏感程度較低的無人機及零組件，則將延後6個月實施。
白宮表示，無人機已成為現代武裝衝突中的重要技術，美國必須迅速提高本土產量，才能維護國家安全及經濟安全。
這項政策也是川普政府推動製造業回流的最新行動。美方希望透過關稅提高進口產品成本，為本土供應商創造更多市場空間，同時降低國防及商用無人機產業對中國製造的依賴。
大西洋理事會2024年發布的研究估計，中國企業掌握約90%的美國無人機市場，全球市占率則約達80%，凸顯美國供應鏈高度集中於中國的情況。
Unusual Machines領漲無人機概念股
關稅政策公布後，投資人迅速買進美國本土無人機及國防企業股票。Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) 強勢噴高逾24%
該公司2024年曾揭露，川普長子小唐納 (Donald Trump Jr.) 擔任公司顧問；當時另一份監管文件顯示，小唐納持有331,580股Unusual Machines股票。
其他無人機及國防類股也同步上揚：

Red Cat (RCAT-US) 強升逾8%。
AeroVironment (AVAV-US) 上漲約2%。
Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS-US) 上漲約3%。
諾斯洛普格魯曼 (NOC-US) 收高約2%。

items.title_en: Berkshire Boosts Alphabet Stake to Third Largest Holding, Adds More Delta Air Lines and Homebuilders
paras: 波克夏·海瑟威 (BRK.B-US) 第二季明顯加快資金部署，大幅增持Google與YouTube母公司Alphabet (GOOGL-US)，使其一舉躍升為波克夏第三大股票投資，僅次於蘋果 (AAPL-US) 與美國運通 (AXP-US)。
根據波克夏週五提交 13-F 監管文件，截至6月30日，公司持有近1.06億股Alphabet股票，高於3月底的5,780萬股，單季持股數大增83%；以季末股價計算，這筆投資價值約378億美元。
這份申報文件主要揭露波克夏截至第二季末持有的美國上市股票，相關部位涵蓋其大部分股票投資組合。波克夏當時整體股票資產規模約3,238億美元，意味Alphabet已占約11.7%。
100億美元私募投資推升持股規模
波克夏持有的Alphabet股票大幅增加，主要反映公司6月初宣布的100億美元私募股票投資。Alphabet為支應龐大的人工智慧 (AI) 基礎設施建設，引進波克夏資金，使雙方合作受到市場高度關注。
目前擔任波克夏董事長的巴菲特 (Warren Buffett) 7月接受CNBC訪問時表示，投資Alphabet的構想由他主導，並獲執行長阿貝爾 (Greg Abel) 支持。
擴大航空業布局 加碼達美航空
