paras_en: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.B-US) markedly accelerated its capital deployment in the second quarter, sharply increasing its stake in Alphabet (GOOGL-US), the parent of Google and YouTube, propelling it to become Berkshire's third‑largest equity investment, behind only Apple (AAPL-US) and American Express (AXP-US).

According to the 13‑F filing Berkshire submitted on Friday, as of June 30 the company held nearly 106 million shares of Alphabet, up from 57.8 million at the end of March, an 83% jump in holdings for the quarter; at quarter‑end prices the investment is worth roughly $37.8 billion.

The filing primarily disclosed Berkshire's U.S. listed equity positions as of the end of the second quarter, covering most of its stock portfolio. Berkshire's total equity assets were about $323.8 billion at that time, meaning Alphabet accounted for approximately 11.7% of the portfolio.
$10 billion private‑placement investment expands stake size

Berkshire's large increase in Alphabet shares mainly reflects a $10 billion private‑placement equity investment announced by the company in early June. Alphabet is seeking massive AI infrastructure spending and brought in Berkshire’s capital, drawing strong market attention to the partnership.
When interviewed by CNBC in July, Berkshire Chairman Warren Buffett said the idea to invest in Alphabet was driven by him and backed by CEO Greg Abel.
Expanding its airline exposure, Berkshire adds to Delta Air Lines

In addition to Alphabet, Berkshire also expanded its airline exposure in the second quarter, raising its Delta Air Lines (DAL‑US) holding by 44% to 57.3 million shares; at June‑end prices the stake is valued at about $5.4 billion.

Berkshire had sold off its airline holdings entirely at the start of the COVID‑19 pandemic and only recently re‑established a position in Delta. This further increase signals a clear shift in the company’s attitude toward the airline sector.
Increasing its stake in Lennar and taking a tiny new position in D.R. Horton
The residential market was another area where Berkshire raised its exposure in the second quarter.

Berkshire increased its holding in homebuilder Lennar (LEN‑US) and disclosed, for the first time, a position in D.R. Horton (DHI‑US), though the new stake is minuscule—only 3,600 shares as of June‑end.
In the same quarter Berkshire completed its acquisition of homebuilder Taylor Morrison, further expanding its footprint in residential construction and real estate.
Ending a 14‑quarter streak of net stock sales, cash falls to $365.5 billion
With Berkshire ramping up equity purchases again, net stock buying in the second quarter approached $20 billion, ending a 14‑quarter run as a net seller of stocks.

As of June‑end, Berkshire’s cash balance slipped from a record $397.4 billion at the end of March to $365.5 billion. The reduction in cash reflects the company’s shift toward deploying more capital into the market through equity investments, share repurchases and corporate acquisitions.

items.title: OpenAI財務長：企業營收已超越消費者業務
items.title_en: OpenAI CFO: Enterprise Revenue Exceeds Consumer Business
paras: 《CNBC》報導，在OpenAI高層經歷動盪的一周後，財務長Sarah Friar周五(14日)與投資人舉行會議，強調公司企業業務的成長。她表示，目前企業業務的營收已超越以ChatGPT為主的消費者業務。
一名出席會議的知情人士透露，Friar在會中表示，「我們今年初的比例是60比40，但企業業務成長速度遠超預期，如今兩者的比例已經交叉。目前我們大部分的營收都來自企業業務。」
這代表OpenAI的企業業務成長已超越先前預期。Friar今年稍早接受CNBC採訪時曾表示，公司原本預期這兩項業務將在2026年底達到相當規模。OpenAI目前的年化營收規模已達400億美元。
根據CNBC看到的簡報資料，OpenAI的年化營收7月較前一個月增加20%，企業客戶營收成長速度更快，增加32%。
知情人士表示，周五的投資人會議在本周高層離職事件發生前就已安排，參與者為OpenAI現有股東。會議舉行前一天，營收長Denise Dresser宣布離職，上任僅8個月。Dresser曾在Salesforce(CRM-US)任職超過10年，最近則擔任Slack執行長。她在LinkedIn發文表示，將離開公司尋求其他發展機會。
兩天前，OpenAI資深高層Brad Lightcap也宣布結束自己在這家ChatGPT開發商長達8年的任期。
OpenAI總裁兼共同創辦人Greg Brockman也參加了周五的會議。知情人士表示，Brockman感謝Dresser對公司的貢獻，以及她為企業業務奠定的基礎，並對接替她的Dali Rajic表示期待。Rajic此前擔任網路安全公司Wiz的營運長，Wiz目前已由Google(GOOGL-US)收購。
知情人士透露，Rajic是透過Thrive創辦人Josh Kushner的介紹加入OpenAI。
與會高層也被問及中國開源模型崛起所帶來的競爭。知情人士表示，Brockman淡化了這項競爭威脅，並指出市場對「開源模型比較便宜」存在誤解。
高層也被問到公司何時可能進行首次公開募股(IPO)。但由於OpenAI已向美國證券管理委員會(SEC)提交機密文件，管理層無法對此談論。
Friar在會中強調營收成長，並表示公司正在因應客戶使用方式的改變。所謂的「狂燒Token」(tokenmaxxing)時代已經過去，也就是企業不再允許員工在沒有展現足夠產出的情況下，無限制累積龐大的AI支出。
知情人士引述Friar的說法指出，「企業客戶已經從狂燒Token轉向關注每單位智慧的成本。」她並強調，OpenAI最新模型在代理型程式設計任務上的效率提高54%，同時公司近期也下調了旗下模型系列的價格。
Friar也表示，OpenAI在廣告業務方面「取得重大進展」。該名知情人士指出，OpenAI廣告業務的年化營收規模已接近10億美元。OpenAI今年2月開始在ChatGPT測試廣告。
paras_en: CNBC reported that OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar held a meeting with investors on Friday (14th) after a week of turmoil among the company's top executives, emphasizing the growth of the company's enterprise business. She stated that the current revenue of the enterprise business has surpassed that of the consumer business led by ChatGPT.

A source who attended the meeting revealed that Friar stated in the meeting, "We were at 60-40 at the beginning of this year, but the growth rate of the enterprise business far exceeded our expectations, and now the two have crossed over. Most of our revenue now comes from the enterprise business."

This represents that OpenAI's enterprise business has grown beyond previous expectations. Friar had previously stated in an interview with CNBC that the company expected the two businesses to reach a similar scale by the end of 2026. OpenAI's annual revenue has now reached $40 billion.

According to the presentation materials seen by CNBC, OpenAI's annual revenue increased by 20% in July compared to the previous month, with enterprise customer revenue growth even faster, increasing by 32%.

The source stated that the investor meeting on Friday had been scheduled before the high-level departure event this week, and the participants were existing shareholders of OpenAI. The day before the meeting, revenue chief Denise Dresser announced her resignation, having been in office for only 8 months. Dresser had worked at Salesforce (CRM-US) for over 10 years and had recently served as the CEO of Slack. She stated on LinkedIn that she would be leaving the company to seek new development opportunities.
Two days ago, OpenAI's senior executive Brad Lightcap also announced the end of his 8-year tenure at the company, which developed ChatGPT.

OpenAI CEO and co-founder Greg Brockman also attended the meeting on Friday. The source stated that Brockman thanked Dresser for her contributions to the company and the foundation she laid for the enterprise business, and expressed his expectations for her replacement, Dali Rajic. Rajic had previously served as the operating chief of network security company Wiz, which was acquired by Google (GOOGL-US).
The source revealed that Rajic was introduced to OpenAI through Thrive founder Josh Kushner.

The attending executives were also asked about the competition brought by the rise of open-source models in China. The source stated that Brockman downplayed the threat of this competition and pointed out that the market had a misconception about the cost-effectiveness of open-source models.

The executives were also asked when the company might conduct its initial public offering (IPO). However, since OpenAI had submitted confidential documents to the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), the management team was unable to discuss this.

Friar emphasized revenue growth in the meeting and stated that the company is responding to changes in customer usage patterns. The "tokenmaxxing" era is over, meaning that companies no longer allow employees to accumulate large AI expenses without demonstrating sufficient output.

The source quoted Friar as saying, "Enterprise customers have moved from tokenmaxxing to focusing on the cost of each unit of intelligence." She emphasized that OpenAI's latest model has improved efficiency by 54% in proxy programming tasks, and the company has recently reduced the prices of its model series.

Friar also stated that OpenAI has made "significant progress" in its advertising business. The source stated that OpenAI's annual revenue from advertising has reached nearly $1 billion. OpenAI began testing advertising on ChatGPT in February this year.

items.title: 為何9月是美股最慘月份？專家揭「南瓜拿鐵效應」 心理症狀引發季節性賣壓
items.title_en: Why September is the worst month for US stocks? Experts reveal the 'pumpkin spice latte effect'
paras: 9月一向是美股表現最弱的月份，MarketWatch專欄作家Mark Hulbert指出，投資人最好提高警覺：研究人員發現，隨著夏末到來，咖啡店開始大力促銷南瓜風味拿鐵時，消費者心情也隨著夏季將結束而日漸低迷，這可能導致股市跟著走弱。
根據道瓊市場數據分析，9月一向是美股報酬率表現最弱的月份。自道瓊工業平均指數在1890年代末創立以來，9月股市上漲的機率只有43%，其餘11個月份則為60%。不僅如此，9月平均報酬率為-1.1%，其他11個月份則平均上漲0.8%。這兩組平均值之間的差異，達到統計學95%信賴水準。
對投資人來說，9月是一年中表現最差月份這件事一直是個謎，統計學家也不斷提醒人們，在缺乏合理解釋的情況下，光憑歷史數據押注9月股市下跌的風險仍然太高。
Hulbert則指出，「南瓜香料拿鐵效應」或許可以提供部分解釋。
根據心理學家，在夏季轉入秋季時出現的低落情緒，是季節性情緒障礙(SAD)的一種表現。而SAD對股市有很大的影響，一項名為「季節性資產配置：來自共同基金資金流的證據」(Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows)的研究發現，股市與SAD之間存在強烈的反向關聯。
英屬哥倫比亞大學(UBC)憂鬱症研究教授Raymond Lam指出，SAD症狀通常與1月、2月等冬季月份相，但但真正影響股市的並不是SAD的絕對程度，而是SAD程度從這個月到下個月的變化，而8月到9月之間的變化，正好是全年最大的。
不過統計數據也顯示，這並不代表股市今年9月一定會表現糟糕，道瓊指數前兩個9月，都以上漲作收。可以確定的是，在一年12個月份中，9月是股市上漲機率最低的月份。
paras_en: September has always been the weakest month for US stocks, according to MarketWatch columnist Mark Hulbert. Investors should be on high alert: researchers found that as summer comes to an end, coffee shops aggressively promote pumpkin-flavored lattes, and consumers' moods also begin to decline, which may lead to a weaker stock market.

According to S&P 500 market data analysis, September has always been the worst-performing month for US stocks. Since the S&P 500 index was established in the late 19th century, the probability of the stock market rising in September is only 43%, while the other 11 months have a 60% chance. Moreover, the average return in September is -1.1%, while the other 11 months have an average return of 0.8%. The difference between these two sets of average values is statistically significant at the 95% confidence level.

For investors, the fact that September is the worst-performing month of the year has always been a mystery. Statisticians have repeatedly warned that relying solely on historical data to bet on a September stock market decline is still too high-risk, even without a clear explanation.
Hulbert suggests that the 'pumpkin spice latte effect' may provide some explanation.

According to psychologists, the low mood that appears when summer turns into autumn is a manifestation of seasonal affective disorder (SAD). SAD has a significant impact on the stock market, and a study titled 'Seasonal Asset Allocation: Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows' found a strong inverse relationship between the stock market and SAD.

UBC professor of depression research Raymond Lam notes that SAD symptoms typically occur in January and February, but the real impact on the stock market is not the absolute level of SAD, but rather the change in SAD levels from one month to the next. The change from August to September is the largest of the year.

However, statistical data also shows that this does not mean that the stock market will definitely perform poorly in September this year. The S&P 500 index has risen in both of the past two Septembers. What is certain is that September has the lowest probability of a stock market rise among the 12 months of the year.

items.title: 摩根大通升評閃迪、目標價2250美元 股價噴漲逾7%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley Upgrades Micron, Targets $2250, Stock Surges Over 7%
paras: 摩根大通 (小摩) 在閃迪 (SNDK-US) 舉行2026年投資人日後，將該股評級從「未評級」調升至「優於大盤」，並給予2027年12月目標價2,250美元。以週五收盤價計算，潛在上漲空間約37%。
閃迪週五 (14日) 飛升超7%，收每股1,641.11美元，盤後續漲1.09%至1,659.02美元，市值來到 2,396億美元。
分析師Harlan Sur指出，閃迪具備掌握AI推論帶動NAND需求成長的有利條件，升評理由主要包括長期供貨協議、NAND市場擴張及技術升級。
閃迪目前已簽署8份長期協議，按照最低價格計算，合約總值約940億美元，加權平均期限超過4年，即使以最低價格供貨，毛利率仍可達約80%。相關合約涵蓋的位元出貨占比，預計將由2027會計年度的逾50%，提高至2028會計年度的約三分之二。
Sur估計，全球NAND潛在市場規模將從2025年的約700億美元，增至2026年的逾3,000億美元，2027年更可能接近5,000億美元，主要受AI資料中心及推論需求帶動。
技術方面，閃迪新一代BiCS10已提前送樣，採用332層、2Tb QLC架構，每片晶圓可生產的位元數較前一代增加65%。公司同時布局高頻寬快閃記憶體，以掌握AI推論市場商機。
閃迪預計，2028至2030會計年度營收年增率可達百分之十幾的中高段，毛利率約80%，調整後自由現金流率約50%。摩根大通並估計，公司2027年每股盈餘可達250美元。
paras_en: Morgan Stanley (small Morgan) upgraded Micron (SNDK-US) after its 2026 investor day, raising its rating to 'outperform' and setting a target price of $2,250 for December 2027. Based on Friday's closing price, the potential upside is approximately 37%.
Micron surged more than 7% on Friday (14th) to $1,641.11 per share, and rose 1.09% after hours to $1,659.02, with a market value of $239.6 billion.

Analyst Harlan Sur noted that Micron has favorable conditions to capture the growth of AI inference-driven NAND demand, with the main reasons for the upgrade including long-term supply agreements, NAND market expansion, and technology upgrades.

Micron has already signed eight long-term agreements, with a total value of approximately $94 billion at the lowest price, and a weighted average term of over four years. Even at the lowest price, the gross margin is expected to be around 80%. The contracts cover a bit more than 50% of the bit shipments in 2027, and are expected to increase to around two-thirds in 2028.

Sur estimates that the global NAND market size will increase from approximately $70 billion in 2025 to over $30 billion in 2026, and may approach $50 billion in 2027, mainly driven by AI data center and inference demand.

Technically, Micron's new generation BiCS10 has been sent out for sampling, using a 332-layer, 2Tb QLC architecture, with each wafer increasing the number of bits produced by 65% compared to the previous generation. The company is also laying out high-speed flash memory to capture the AI inference market opportunity.

Micron expects its revenue growth rate to be in the mid-to-high teens, around 15%, from 2028 to 2030, with a gross margin of around 80% and an adjusted free cash flow rate of around 50%. Morgan Stanley also estimates that the company's 2027 earnings per share will be $250.

items.title: 中國版Apple Intelligence技術路線曝光！核心不用Gemini、改採蘋果自研模型
items.title_en: China Version of Apple Intelligence Technology Roadmap Revealed! Core Not Gemini, Uses Apple’s Own Model
paras: 蘋果正為Apple Intelligence進入中國市場採取不同於海外市場的技術路線。據《路透社》報導，中國版Apple Intelligence將以蘋果自行訓練的大型語言模型為核心，而非直接採用Google Gemini或阿里巴巴的通義千問(Qwen)。
這套模型由蘋果與阿里巴巴合作訓練。雖然主要大型語言模型仍由蘋果主導，但Qwen預計也會以某種形式整合至中國市場銷售的蘋果 (AAPL-US) 裝置，百度的相關技術同樣可能被納入。
這項安排與蘋果在美國等市場的策略有所不同。
海外版Apple Intelligence雖然擁有蘋果自家的基礎模型，但部分進階功能會採用Google Gemini技術，Siri也能透過擴充功能連接OpenAI的ChatGPT。由於Gemini、ChatGPT及Anthropic旗下Claude目前均無法在中國提供服務，蘋果必須另行建立符合當地法規的技術架構。
中國AI法規複雜 蘋果必須借助本土業者
中國對生成式AI服務實施嚴格監管，外國科技公司若要在當地推出相關產品，實際上通常需要與中國企業合作。蘋果因此攜手阿里巴巴，同時導入Qwen及百度技術，以滿足模型訓練、內容審查與監管合規等要求。
先前報導指出，阿里巴巴可能負責中國版Apple Intelligence的內容審查機制，相關限制預料也會同時適用於蘋果自研模型及Qwen提供的功能。
中國監管機關近期已批准Apple Intelligence在當地使用，但服務尚未正式推出，後續仍可能面臨其他監管程序。若最終順利上線，蘋果可望成為率先在中國推出自有AI模型的外國科技公司之一。
上線準備疑似接近完成 蘋果仍未公布時間
蘋果目前尚未公布中國版Apple Intelligence的確切推出日期，但多項跡象顯示相關準備工作已進入後期。今年3月，這項服務一度短暫在中國市場開放，外界推測可能是意外提前上線，也反映技術部署已大致完成。
此外，蘋果支援網站近期曾發布在Mac上使用Qwen的操作指南，隨後又將文件撤下，進一步引發外界對雙方合作即將落地的猜測。
中國長期以來一直是蘋果的重要市場。儘管iPhone過去數年在當地銷售一度明顯下滑，但近期情況已有改善，iPhone 17系列在中國的市場表現更優於蘋果原先預期。Apple Intelligence若能順利推出，可望成為蘋果維持中國市場成長動能的重要一環。
paras_en: Apple is taking a different technical approach for Apple Intelligence in the Chinese market compared to overseas markets. According to Reuters, the China version of Apple Intelligence will be built around a large language model trained by Apple itself, rather than directly using Google Gemini or Alibaba’s Tongyi Qwen.

The model is being trained in collaboration between Apple and Alibaba. While the primary large language model remains Apple‑led, Qwen is expected to be integrated in some form into Apple (AAPL‑US) devices sold in China, and Baidu’s related technology may also be incorporated.
This arrangement differs from Apple’s strategy in the United States and other markets.

The overseas version of Apple Intelligence, although based on Apple’s own foundational model, uses Google Gemini for some advanced features, and Siri can connect to OpenAI’s ChatGPT via extensions. Because Gemini, ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude are currently unavailable in China, Apple must build a separate technical architecture that complies with local regulations.
China’s AI regulations are complex; Apple must rely on domestic partners

China imposes strict oversight on generative AI services, and foreign tech firms typically need to partner with Chinese companies to launch such products locally. Consequently, Apple is teaming up with Alibaba and also bringing in Qwen and Baidu technologies to meet requirements for model training, content moderation and regulatory compliance.

Earlier reports indicated that Alibaba may handle the content‑review mechanism for the China version of Apple Intelligence, and the related restrictions are expected to apply to both Apple’s own model and the functions provided by Qwen.

Chinese regulators have recently approved the use of Apple Intelligence in the country, but the service has not yet been officially launched and may still face additional regulatory steps. If it goes live smoothly, Apple could become one of the first foreign tech companies to launch its own AI model in China.
Launch preparations appear to be nearing completion, but Apple has not announced a timeline

Apple has not disclosed a specific rollout date for the China version of Apple Intelligence, yet several signs suggest that preparations are in the final stages. In March this year the service was briefly opened in the Chinese market, which observers think may have been an accidental early launch and indicates that the technical deployment is largely finished.
In addition, Apple’s support site recently posted a guide on using Qwen on Mac, then removed the document, further fueling speculation that the partnership is about to be realized.

China has long been a key market for Apple. Although iPhone sales in the country had noticeably declined in recent years, the situation has improved lately, with the iPhone 17 series performing better in China than Apple originally expected. If Apple Intelligence is successfully launched, it could become an important driver for sustaining Apple’s growth momentum in the Chinese market.

items.title: 高市批普丁訪千島群島「絕對不可接受」
items.title_en: Japan PM Sanae Takaichi Slams Putin's Visit to Kuril Islands
paras: 《CNBC》報導，日本首相高市早苗(Sanae Takaichi)批評俄羅斯總統普丁(Vladimir Putin)首度訪問存在主權爭議的千島群島(Kuril Islands)，並表示這些島嶼是「日本固有領土」。
高市周四在X平台發文表示，東京「一再要求俄方確保總統不要訪問北方領土」。日本所稱的「北方領土」即指千島群島。
她並表示，普丁此次訪問「絕對不可接受」。
千島群島位於俄羅斯堪察加半島(Kamchatka Peninsula)南端與日本北海道東北端之間。這片人口稀少的火山群島將鄂霍次克海(Sea of Okhotsk)與太平洋分隔開來。群島最南端的4座島嶼，於第二次世界大戰末期蘇聯發動入侵日本領土時遭其併吞。
普丁此次訪問期間前往擇捉島(Iturup)，俄羅斯在當地設有具重要戰略地位的軍事基地。普丁參觀了一座水產加工廠、醫院及學校，之後與薩哈林州州長Valery Limarenko舉行會談。
日本外務大臣茂木敏充(Toshimitsu Motegi)也批評這次訪問。他在臉書發文表示，「日本強烈抗議此次訪問」。
日本在1951年《舊金山和約》(Treaty of San Francisco)中放棄「對千島群島的一切權利、權原及請求」，但並未承認蘇聯對該地區擁有主權。
這項島嶼爭議也使東京與莫斯科自二戰結束後一直未能簽署和平條約，儘管兩國在1956年簽署的《日蘇共同宣言》結束了雙方的戰爭狀態。
美國智庫「戰爭研究所」(Institute for the Study of War)分析師表示，普丁此次訪問可能是克里姆林宮對日本最新防衛白皮書所做的回應，目的是削弱高市強化日本防衛能力的努力。
日本在本月稍早公布新版防衛白皮書，引發普丁及俄羅斯盟友北韓的批評。俄羅斯總統批評該白皮書將莫斯科列為日本面臨的主要威脅之一。
白皮書指出，「俄羅斯持續在北方領土進行積極的軍事活動，這些地區是日本固有領土，目前處於非法占領。」
paras_en: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi criticized Russian President Vladimir Putin's first visit to the disputed Kuril Islands, calling them "Japanese inherent territory".
Takaichi posted on X on Thursday that Tokyo "has repeatedly asked Russia to ensure the president does not visit the northern territories," referring to the Kuril Islands.
She also stated that Putin's visit "is absolutely unacceptable".

The Kuril Islands are located between the southern end of Russia's Kamchatka Peninsula and the northeastern end of Japan's Hokkaido. The sparsely populated volcanic island chain separates the Sea of Okhotsk from the Pacific Ocean.

During his visit, Putin traveled to Iturup, where Russia has a strategically important military base. He visited a seafood processing plant, a hospital, and a school, and then held talks with Sakhalin Governor Valery Limarenko.
Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi also criticized the visit, posting on Facebook that "Japan strongly protests this visit".
Japan relinquished "all rights, title, and interest" to the Kuril Islands in the 1951 Treaty of San Francisco, but did not recognize Soviet ownership of the region.

The island dispute has prevented Tokyo and Moscow from signing a peace treaty since the end of World War II, despite the 1956 Soviet-Japanese Joint Declaration ending the state of war between the two countries.

An analyst from the US think tank Institute for the Study of War suggested that Putin's visit may be a response to the Kremlin's concerns over Japan's latest defense white paper, aimed at weakening Takaichi's efforts to strengthen Japan's defense capabilities.

Japan released a new defense white paper earlier this month, which sparked criticism from Putin and Russia's ally North Korea. Putin criticized the white paper for listing Moscow as one of Japan's main threats.
The white paper states that "Russia continues to engage in active military activities in the northern territories, which are Japanese inherent territory and are currently under illegal occupation."

items.title: 上市前關鍵里程碑！Anthropic Q2營收暴增為14倍 調整後營業利益首度轉正
items.title_en: IPO Milestone! Anthropic Q2 Revenue Surges 14-Fold, Adjusted Profit Turns Positive
paras: Anthropic向潛在投資人表示，第2季營收暴增為至少去年同期的14倍，不僅如此，調整後營業利益已經轉正，象徵該公司在衝刺首次公開發行(IPO)階段所達到的一個關鍵營運里程碑。
根據彭博取得的文件，Anthropic第2季的初步營收超過115億美元，高於2025年同期的7.87億美元，也較今年第1季的47.3億美元大幅成長。這份文件還顯示，Anthropic在今年第2季的調整後營業利益已經轉正。
截至5月，Anthropic的年化營收預估值已突破470億美元，主要受惠於企業專業人士採用率持續攀升。
這波快速擴張凸顯Anthropic與長期競爭對手OpenAI之間的競爭日益白熱化。根據近期報導，OpenAI的年化營收預估值已超過400億美元，儘管兩家公司計算的方式可能不同，但這些數據仍顯示，隨著企業客戶加速增加人工智慧(AI)支出，企業AI市場的競爭正變得更加激烈。
Anthropic據悉今年秋季可能發動超大型IPO，目前正積極與潛在投資人會面，討論公司未來的財務發展。據悉Anthropic已秘密提交IPO申請，並與摩根士丹利(Morgan Stanley)、高盛(Goldman Sachs)及摩根大通(JPMorgan Chase)的顧問團隊合作籌備上市案。
如果Anthropic今年秋季IPO，上市時間將不僅早於OpenAI，也可能早於中國AI業者DeepSeek。DeepSeek近來正逐步搶占AI技術市場版圖占知情人士透露，該公司正在準備IPO，最快可能今年就提交上市申請。
AI競賽也點燃IPO市場熱度。根據彭博彙整的數據，不包括特殊目的收購公司(SPAC)及其他金融工具，今年以來IPO募集資金已達2564億美元，這將是2021年以來IPO募資金額最高的一年。
paras_en: Anthropic has informed potential investors that its second-quarter revenue has surged at least 14 times that of the same period last year, not only that, but its adjusted profit has turned positive, marking a crucial operational milestone for the company as it gears up for its initial public offering (IPO).

According to a document obtained by Bloomberg, Anthropic's preliminary second-quarter revenue exceeded $11.5 billion, surpassing $787 million in the same period last year and significantly growing from $4.73 billion in the first quarter of this year. The document also shows that Anthropic's adjusted profit has turned positive in the second quarter of this year.
As of May, Anthropic's annualized revenue estimate has broken through $47 billion, mainly driven by the continued increase in adoption rates among corporate professionals.

This rapid expansion highlights the intensifying competition between Anthropic and its long-term rival OpenAI. According to recent reports, OpenAI's annualized revenue estimate has exceeded $40 billion, despite the possible differences in calculation methods, these data still show that as corporate clients accelerate their spending on artificial intelligence (AI), the competition in the enterprise AI market is becoming increasingly fierce.

Anthropic is reportedly planning to launch a massive IPO in the fall of this year, actively meeting with potential investors to discuss the company's future financial development. It is said that Anthropic has secretly submitted an IPO application and is working with a team of advisors from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, and JPMorgan Chase to prepare for the listing.

If Anthropic goes public in the fall of this year, its listing time will not only be earlier than OpenAI's, but it may also be earlier than that of Chinese AI player DeepSeek. DeepSeek is currently gradually occupying the map of AI technology market shares, insiders revealed that the company is preparing for an IPO, which may submit a listing application as early as this year.

The AI competition has also ignited the IPO market's enthusiasm. According to data compiled by Bloomberg, excluding special-purpose acquisition companies (SPACs) and other financial instruments, the total amount of IPO fundraising this year has reached $256.4 billion, which will be the highest IPO fundraising amount since 2021.

items.title: 川普祭無人機100%重稅 無人機股全面升空
paras: 川普政府宣布對外國製無人機及關鍵零組件加徵新關稅，藉此降低美國對中國供應鏈的依賴，並加速擴充本土產能。政策消息帶動美國無人機及國防類股週五 (14 日) 全面走高，Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) 強勢噴高逾24%，成為市場焦點。
根據白宮公布的措施，具備熱成像等軍事敏感功能的大型無人機，以及被認定為關鍵的無人機零組件，將面臨100%關稅；小型無人機及敏感程度較低的零組件則適用25%稅率。
日本、英國等特定國家的產品可適用較低稅率。多數新關稅預計於9月生效，至於敏感程度較低的無人機及零組件，則將延後6個月實施。
白宮表示，無人機已成為現代武裝衝突中的重要技術，美國必須迅速提高本土產量，才能維護國家安全及經濟安全。
這項政策也是川普政府推動製造業回流的最新行動。美方希望透過關稅提高進口產品成本，為本土供應商創造更多市場空間，同時降低國防及商用無人機產業對中國製造的依賴。
大西洋理事會2024年發布的研究估計，中國企業掌握約90%的美國無人機市場，全球市占率則約達80%，凸顯美國供應鏈高度集中於中國的情況。
Unusual Machines領漲無人機概念股
關稅政策公布後，投資人迅速買進美國本土無人機及國防企業股票。Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) 強勢噴高逾24%
該公司2024年曾揭露，川普長子小唐納 (Donald Trump Jr.) 擔任公司顧問；當時另一份監管文件顯示，小唐納持有331,580股Unusual Machines股票。
其他無人機及國防類股也同步上揚：

Red Cat (RCAT-US) 強升逾8%。
AeroVironment (AVAV-US) 上漲約2%。
Kratos Defense & Security Solutions (KTOS-US) 上漲約3%。
諾斯洛普格魯曼 (NOC-US) 收高約2%。
Aevex (AVEX-US) 上漲約2%。
Ondas Holdings (ONDS-US) 上漲約3.6%。


Ondas週四公布第二季財報，業績表現好壞參半，但在新關稅帶動本土無人機產業前景升溫之下，股價仍跟隨族群走高。
美國加碼扶植本土無人機產業
除了加徵關稅，美國政府也正透過預算及採購計畫擴大本土無人機產能。美國國防部去年12月啟動規模10億美元的「無人機主導」(Drone Dominance) 計畫，希望加快本土無人機製造及部署。
川普提出的2027財政年度預算案，國防支出規模達1.5兆美元，其中也將強化美國無人機生產列為重點。
新關稅配合國防採購與預算支持，顯示川普政府正從進口限制、政府資金及供應鏈重組等多個層面扶植本土產業。市場預期，美國無人機製造商可望受惠於進口產品成本上升，以及政府訂單與國防需求持續增加。

items.title_en: Key US Stock News Summary August 15, 2026
paras:
AI晶片融資風險疑雲 博通下殺近6%、市值跌破1.9兆美元

博通 (AVGO-US) 週五 (14日) 重挫5.94%，收每股392.99美元，盤中最低一度下探388.50美元。美國銀行估計，為博通AI晶片客戶提供資金的融資平台，到2029年年中可能累積3,700億美元債務。雖然這些債務並非由博通直接背負，但公司已替部分客戶的設備租金提供擔保，引發市場對潛在損失的擔憂。全文詳讀

輝達持有SpaceX約210億美元股權 持股市值已縮水至172億美元

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元因降息預期升溫走低 本周仍終結連兩周跌勢
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Falls as Rate‑Cut Expectations Rise, Ending Two‑Week Decline This Week
paras: 美元周五(14日)走低，最新公布的經濟數據進一步促使市場重新調整對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。不過，受中東外交僵局推升油價，進而增加避險需求的帶動，美元本周仍終結連續兩周跌勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報99.67。本周上漲約0.1%。
這周市場主要關注美國關鍵通膨數據，以及周五公布的零售銷售數據，以尋找貨幣政策走向的線索。這些數據顯示價格壓力正在降溫、消費支出也有所放緩，加上上周公布的就業報告意外疲弱，使聯準會立即收緊貨幣政策的壓力有所減輕。
周三公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示，7月整體及核心通膨年增率均放緩。周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)也呈現類似趨勢，整體及核心指數年增速度均較為溫和。
美國人口普查局周五表示，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，至7,636億美元，遠低於市場預期的成長0.1%。核心零售銷售則月減0.3%，市場原先預期成長0.2%。
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams表示，「隨著汽油及其他能源價格上漲推高生活成本，消費者減少了非必要支出。6月個人儲蓄率更降至2022年年中以來最低水準。」
他指出，「細項數據其實沒有整體數字看起來那麼糟。加油站銷售下滑其實是好消息，因為這反映價格下降。此外，亞馬遜Prime Day今年提前至6月底舉行，而不是像去年一樣在7月舉行，也導致非店面零售銷售疲弱。但即使排除這些一次性因素，零售支出上個月仍然下滑。」
市場也相應調整了對聯準會利率走向的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率已升至約67%，高於一周前的近56%。升息1碼的機率則從一周前約44%降至接近33%。
Adams補充，「7月疲弱的零售銷售數據進一步降低了聯準會在9月下一次會議升息的機率。」
在CPI及PPI數據公布後，對利率敏感的美國公債殖利率周三、周四走低，因交易員大量買進債券。殖利率周五反彈，使10年期美債殖利率本周轉為上漲。不過，短天期的2年期美債殖利率本周仍下跌。
這周經濟數據對美元構成壓力，但油價上漲則抵銷了部分影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲1.7%，至每桶88.52美元，本周累計上漲4.5%。
油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗就關鍵水道荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權陷入僵局的影響。雙方均各自宣稱擁有這條重要水道的控制權，而德黑蘭則堅持華盛頓必須滿足包括停止各戰線敵對行動，以及解凍伊朗資產等要求，荷姆茲海峽才能重新開放。
美國目前正考慮無限期維持對伊朗的海上封鎖，結束衝突並恢復海峽正常航運的努力仍陷入停滯。通過這條航線的油輪數量已大幅減少，引發市場對石油供應中斷的擔憂。此外，伊朗支持的葉門「青年運動」(Houthis)在另一條重要海灣航運通道——曼德海峽(Bab el-Mandeb Strait)發動的船隻襲擊，進一步加劇相關疑慮。
日元本周貶值1%
其他主要貨幣方面，日元週五走強，但本周兌美元仍貶值約1%。
在華盛頓與東京於上月底進行歷史性聯合干預後，日元未能守住相關漲幅，近兩周持續兌美元走弱。

paras_en: The dollar slipped on Friday (the 14th), as the latest economic data prompted the market to revise its expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. However, higher oil prices driven by a diplomatic deadlock in the Middle East boosted safe‑haven demand, allowing the dollar to break its two‑week losing streak this week.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 99.67, up about 0.1% for the week.

This week the market focused on key U.S. inflation figures and Friday’s retail sales data to gauge the direction of monetary policy. The numbers showed cooling price pressure and a slowdown in consumer spending, and together with last week’s unexpectedly weak jobs report, eased pressure on the Fed to tighten policy immediately.

Wednesday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed that both headline and core inflation year‑over‑year rates slowed in July. Thursday’s Producer Price Index (PPI) displayed a similar trend, with overall and core indices posting modest year‑over‑year growth.

The U.S. Census Bureau reported on Friday that July retail sales fell 0.6% month‑over‑month to $763.6 billion, far below the market’s expectation of a 0.1% increase. Core retail sales dropped 0.3% month‑over‑month, versus an anticipated 0.2% rise.

Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, said, “Higher gasoline and other energy prices have pushed up living costs, prompting consumers to cut back on non‑essential spending. The personal savings rate fell in June to its lowest level since mid‑2022.”

He added, “The granular data aren’t as bad as the headline numbers suggest. The decline in gas‑station sales is actually good news because it reflects lower prices. Amazon’s Prime Day was moved up to the end of June this year instead of July, which also contributed to weaker non‑store retail sales. Even after stripping out these one‑off factors, retail spending still fell last month.”

The market also adjusted its expectations for Fed rate moves. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September has risen to about 67%, up from roughly 56% a week earlier. The odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike fell from about 44% to near 33% over the same period.
Adams further noted, “Weak July retail sales data further reduce the likelihood of a rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.”

After the CPI and PPI releases, yields on rate‑sensitive U.S. Treasuries fell on Wednesday and Thursday as traders bought bonds in large volumes. Yields rebounded on Friday, turning the 10‑year Treasury yield into a weekly gain, while the short‑term two‑year yield continued to decline for the week.
This week’s economic data put pressure on the dollar, but the rise in oil prices offset part of that impact. Brent crude futures were up 1.7% at $88.52 a barrel, a weekly gain of 4.5%.

The oil price increase was mainly driven by a stalemate between the United States and Iran over control of the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Both sides claim authority over the waterway, and Tehran insists Washington must meet demands—including halting hostile actions on all fronts and unfreezing Iranian assets—before the strait can be reopened.

The United States is currently considering an indefinite maritime blockade of Iran, and efforts to end the conflict and restore normal shipping through the strait have stalled. The number of tankers using the route has dropped sharply, raising concerns about oil‑supply disruptions. In addition, Iran‑backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have attacked vessels in another key shipping lane, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, further heightening worries.
The yen depreciated about 1% this week.
Among other major currencies, the yen strengthened on Friday but still ended the week down roughly 1% against the dollar.
After a historic joint intervention by Washington and Tokyo at the end of last month, the yen failed to hold its gains and has weakened against the dollar for nearly two consecutive weeks.
Conversely, both the euro and the pound rose this week, with the euro up about 0.1% on a weekly basis and the pound gaining roughly 0.3%.

items.title: 川普政府再出手！美國要求歐盟拆除永續法規等非關稅壁壘
items.title_en: Trump Administration Acts Again! U.S. Demands EU Dismantle Sustainability Regulations and Other Non‑Tariff Barriers
paras: 美國周五(14日)再度向歐盟施壓，要求放寬企業永續與碳排相關法規，並履行先前承諾，確保這些規定不會對歐美貿易造成不當限制。不過，歐盟強調自身監管自主權不容談判，顯示雙方在關稅協議生效後，角力焦點正轉向非關稅貿易壁壘。
美國駐歐盟大使普茲德(Andrew Puzder)在社群平台X發文表示，歐盟應履行2025年7月在蘇格蘭坦伯利與美國總統川普進行貿易談判時作出的承諾。根據雙方架構協議，歐盟承諾確保《企業永續盡職調查指令》(CSDDD)與《企業永續報告指令》(CSRD)不會對跨大西洋貿易構成不當限制。
普茲德指出，這些法規的域外適用條款將損害美國企業與勞工，受影響的也不會只有美國。相關規定要求在歐盟營運的大型企業，包括美國公司，揭露其全球供應鏈對環境與社會造成的影響，其中涵蓋碳排放及勞動條件。
歐盟執委會發言人回應，美歐仍在就關稅與非關稅議題進行協商，歐盟也已向美方說明相關規範，並願意合作擴大雙邊貿易。不過，發言人強調，歐盟的法規架構及監管自主權均「不在談判範圍內」。
除企業永續規定外，華盛頓也要求歐盟修改碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)。該制度對未達歐盟碳排標準的進口商品徵收費用，美方認為這可能使美國出口商承受額外負擔。
知情人士預期，美歐可能在今年秋季發表聯合聲明，處理坦伯利協議中的非關稅議題。歐盟過去一年已放寬部分遭美方批評的政策，包括反森林砍伐法規及甲烷排放規定，但熟悉歐盟立場的人士表示，布魯塞爾目前無意進一步讓步。
歐盟去年也因企業與美國、卡達等政府反彈，縮減企業永續法規的適用範圍。去年12月通過的修正案將CSDDD限縮至最大型企業，合規期限延後兩年至2029年中；CSRD則僅適用於員工超過1,000人的企業，門檻遠高於原先的250人。
包括艾克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的美國企業仍要求更大幅度調整，甚至主張全面豁免外國公司。美方表示，雖肯定歐盟去年12月永續法規整合修正案的部分改革，但相關措施仍未充分解決美國對這兩項指令的疑慮。
paras_en: The United States pressed the EU again on Friday the 14th, demanding that it ease corporate sustainability and carbon‑related regulations and honor its earlier pledge to ensure those rules do not create undue restrictions on trans‑Atlantic trade. The EU, however, stressed that its regulatory autonomy is non‑negotiable, indicating that after the tariff agreement takes effect the focus of the dispute is shifting to non‑tariff trade barriers.

U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder posted on X that the EU must fulfill the commitment made in July 2025 during trade talks with President Trump in Tanfield, Scotland. Under the framework agreement, the EU pledged to ensure that the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD) and the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) will not constitute improper constraints on trans‑Atlantic commerce.

Puzder warned that the extraterritorial provisions of these regulations would harm U.S. companies and workers, and the impact would not be limited to the United States. The rules require large firms operating in the EU, including U.S. firms, to disclose the environmental and social impacts of their global supply chains, covering carbon emissions and labour conditions.

An EU Commission spokesperson responded that the U.S. and EU are still negotiating tariff and non‑tariff issues, that the EU has explained the relevant rules to Washington and is willing to cooperate to expand bilateral trade. However, the spokesperson stressed that the EU’s regulatory framework and supervisory autonomy are “outside the scope of negotiations.”

Beyond corporate sustainability rules, Washington also wants the EU to modify its Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). That system levies fees on imported goods that do not meet EU carbon‑emission standards, which the U.S. says could impose extra burdens on American exporters.

Informed sources expect the U.S. and EU may issue a joint statement this autumn to address the non‑tariff issues in the Tanfield agreement. Over the past year the EU has eased some policies criticized by the U.S., such as anti‑deforestation rules and methane‑emission standards, but insiders say Brussels is currently unwilling to make further concessions.

The EU also scaled back the scope of its corporate sustainability regulations last year after pushback from the United States, Qatar and other governments. An amendment passed in December limited the CSDDD to the largest firms, pushing the compliance deadline back two years to mid‑2029, while the CSRD now applies only to companies with more than 1,000 employees, a threshold far higher than the original 250‑employee benchmark.

U.S. firms, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), continue to demand far greater adjustments and even argue for a full exemption for foreign companies. The U.S. acknowledges some of the reforms in the EU’s December 2023 sustainability‑law integration amendment but says the measures still do not adequately address American concerns over the two directives.

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度升破32元大關 收32.046元 強升1.22角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Briefly Broke the 32‑Per‑Dollar Barrier, Closing at 32.046, a Strong Rise of 1.22 Cents
paras: 新台幣今(14)日再度呈現強升格局，全日處升值態勢，更一度升破32元大關，終場收在32.046元，升值1.22角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.28億美元。

觀察主要亞幣，新台幣收升0.38%，韓元也升值逾0.3%，日元升近0.2%，人民幣、星元小升約0.05%上下，泰銖則小貶0.05%。
統一投顧表示，美國 7 月 CPI 月增 0.1%，符合市場預期，而核心PPI 月增 0.2%，則低於市場預期的 0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會 9 月升息的擔憂。
元大投顧則指出，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外下滑，且最新 CPI 數據如常，使市場擔憂升息程度減輕不少，預期 8 月底全球央行年會前聯準會不至於出現過於鷹派的言論。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar again showed a strong upward trend today (the 14th), staying in appreciation mode throughout the day and at one point breaking the 32‑per‑dollar mark, ultimately closing at 32.046, a gain of 1.22 cents, with the Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage’s transaction volume expanding to US$2.228 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.15, up 0.18 cents, and rose to a high of 31.991 during the session, with a daily price range of 1.59 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

Bloomberg cited insiders saying Prime Minister Kishida’s government backs a near‑term hike, reflecting US Treasury Secretary Yellen’s push after joint intervention for Japan to adopt tighter policy, hinting a shift from dovish stance and allowing BOJ rate hikes. The yield spread between Japanese and US Treasuries is expected to narrow further, providing support for the yen.

Subsequently, the US Labor Department reported initial jobless claims rising to 209,000. July’s final PPI held steady month‑over‑month and fell to 4.7% year‑over‑year, bolstering expectations the Fed will hold rates steady next month. Richmond Fed President Barkin said cooling inflation reduces the need for hikes, pushing the dollar‑yen down to a low of 159.01, while Cleveland Fed President Harker reiterated that the Fed should raise rates promptly to curb inflation. items.title: 挪威央行維持利率4.25%不變 通膨風險與地緣政治仍令政策前景蒙陰
items.title_en: Norway Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% as Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Loom
paras: 挪威央行周四(13日)宣布將基準利率維持在 4.25% 保持不變，此一決定完全符合市場預期，媒體對 16 位分析師進行的調查均準確預測了此結果。
儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息機率降 升值7.8分收32.168元
items.title_en: TWD Rises as Fed Rate Hike Probability Decreases, Closes at 32.168
paras: 隨著外資回補台股，台北匯市受到帶動今(13)日續強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收32.168元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值較昨日擴大至17.22億美元。
新台幣今日以32.22元、升值2.6分開出後，最高來到32.152元，全日高低價差6.8分。
觀察主要亞幣，以新台幣表現較強勁，收升0.24%，美元指數微跌0.02%左右，日元和人民幣小升0.02%上下，星元微貶不到0.05%，泰銖貶約0.1%，韓元則重挫近0.5%。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 7 月 CPI 年增率降至 3.4%、核心 CPI 降至 2.5%，通膨降溫，惟服務價格仍具黏性，加上油價逼近 90 美元，能源通膨風險仍在，預期聯準會短期維持利率不變。
群益投顧也表示，美國7月CPI低於6月的3.5%，核心CPI也從6月的2.6%降至2.5%，皆與市場預期一致，儘管仍明顯高於聯準會設定的2%目標，但與6月數據同樣維持平穩，顯示今年稍早由能源價格推動的通膨正在降溫，市場預期9月聯準會升息機率續降。
paras_en: As foreign capital returns to the Taiwanese stock market, the Taipei foreign exchange market was boosted today, with the New Taiwan dollar (TWD) continuing to rise, closing at 32.168, up 7.8 points, and the trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage Company expanded to $17.22 billion, compared to the previous day.
The TWD opened at 32.22, up 2.6 points, and rose to a high of 32.152 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of 6.8 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the TWD performed relatively strongly, rising 0.24%, while the US dollar index fell slightly by about 0.02%, the Japanese yen and the Chinese yuan rose slightly by around 0.02%, the Singapore dollar fell by less than 0.05%, the Thai baht fell by about 0.1%, and the Korean won plummeted by nearly 0.5%.

According to Cathay Futures research, the US July CPI annual growth rate fell to 3.4%, and the core CPI fell to 2.5%, indicating a decline in inflation, but service prices still have stickiness, and with oil prices approaching $90, energy inflation risks still exist, and it is expected that the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates in the short term.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory also stated that the US July CPI was lower than June's 3.5%, and the core CPI also fell from June's 2.6% to 2.5%, both of which were in line with market expectations, although they were still significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target, but remained stable compared to June's data, indicating that the inflation driven by energy prices earlier this year is easing, and the market expects the probability of a Fed rate hike in September to continue to decline.
